items.text:
During the last 3 months, I spent some of my time and tokens decompiling a popular first-person shooter.
The goal was not to reach a simple proof-of-concept state.
Instead, we really wanted an accurate, stable and feature-complete recreation of the game.

The avid reader of my blog might have noticed that I had previously written two posts that have since been removed.
Everyone else might now be wondering which game I am talking about.
To both of you I can only say that corporate America was here to ruin our fun.

However, that’s fine. This post is not about the game, it’s also less about the process of decompilation.
It’s more about AI orchestration and how to optimize infrastructure, setup and harness for optimal results.

This project was done with the help of RektInator, Future, st0rm and other members of the community. A big thank you to all of them.

What Was Our Goal?

We aimed at an accurate decompilation of the game to C++.
Besides obvious semantic correctness, we had quite a few more requirements:
We wanted readable C++ source that compiles.
Given how old the game is, we also wanted security and bug fixes, but also portability improvements. It would be nice to run the game on Linux, macOS, in the browser, …

We later deferred modernization and portability to focus entirely on reconstructing the original behavior.

Obviously, the overall goal was to learn how to effectively orchestrate autonomous AI agents over the course of months.

The Initial Setup

We started with Claude Max (20x), then added Codex Pro and used both subscriptions simultaneously.
Model choice varied a lot. We had been using Sonnet 5 most of the time, but Opus 5.5, Luna, Sol and Terra were also used a lot.
More on that later.

Claude agents were running in Claude Code CLI, Codex agents in Codex CLI.
We also tried other agent harnesses, but the choice barely mattered, so we stuck to the defaults.

Progress Tracking

Using GitHub CLI, the agents manage GitHub issues to track their progress.
There is one issue per translation unit (.cpp file).
Additionally, labels help group and prioritize issues.

Communication

Agents communicate via Discord.
All of them have access to one channel and can both post and read all messages in there.

Discord allows agent-2-agent communication, as well as human-2-agent.
So other participants can talk to them, without needing machine access.

A GitHub webhook posts CI failures into the shared channel, so agents get notified when something broke.

Disassembly & Decompilation

Agents have been using the official ida-mcp by Hex-Rays almost the entire time.
It works great. It’s super stable, it’s headless and supports everything needed for this project. I can only recommend it.

The First Month

We had 4 agents running at that time.

3 worker agents decompiling and committing and one reviewer agent that passively coordinates and reviews commits to flag bugs.

Agents managed to decompile about 80% of the game and visible progress was made.
The game launched, the main menu was visible and we were able to load maps.

We spent a lot of those 4 weeks optimizing our setup:

We reduced token consumption by triggering earlier compactions.
The default compaction threshold is 90% context fill. We reduced it down to 42%.
Decompilation consists of a lot of volatile information: A function that was decompiled is now irrelevant and could be removed from the context. So earlier compactions help remove such “junk” from the context.

We also noticed that agents tend to lose focus over time. Even within the span of one compaction cycle, agents can drift and lose focus, the more data the context holds.

Agents sometimes moved to another function before finishing the previous one. They also started idling while watching CI, despite receiving failure notifications on Discord. Occasionally, they closed issues without thoroughly checking whether the work was actually complete.

Working side by side in a terminal, you can steer the agents to prevent that, but when letting them work autonomously, steering is not possible.

To prevent that, we wrote a document defining our goal, how agents should work, what they must avoid and how to handle specific situations.

An hourly cron job automatically injected a request for agents to reread this document, keeping the instructions fresh in their context. While this might not be the ideal method to keep agents focused, it worked really well through the end of the project.

Lots of time was spent refining the instruction document. As the content is extremely specific to this project, it makes less sense to share it here, though.

However…

… despite all our efforts optimizing setup and infrastructure, we need to talk about the quality of the work.

Constant progress (game starting, menu rendering, maps loading) led us to believe the quality of the decompilation was great.

It was not. Despite the code being extremely readable, it was semantically wrong.

Agents used wrong function signatures, types or struct layouts.
They invented logic or removed it where deemed unnecessary.

Beyond semantic errors, agents also introduced unnecessary architectural changes.
As an example, the game has certain configuration variables that it accesses via global variables.
The agents had turned this constant memory access into hash tables with a lookup that was orders of magnitude more expensive.

And that’s just one example of the many things that went wrong.

Why is that?

While a reviewer helps catch bugs, it does not work well for anything beyond that.
Architectural decisions were not questioned, as long as they aligned with the goal.

The main reason for that is that we didn’t have objective acceptance criteria.
We never properly defined “correctness”. Therefore it was hard for the reviewer to judge which change is correct and what’s wrong.

Obviously it had the game as reference, but given that we had modernization and portability on the list as well, certain deviations were not treated as bugs.
Interestingly, comments in the commits or code led the reviewer to accept deviations, due to whatever justification the worker agent had written down. The workers’ comments effectively acted as unintentional prompt injection: the reviewer accepted their justifications instead of independently checking the deviations against the original.

The Oracle

What we needed was an automated check that tells agents whether a reconstructed function matches the original. It should verify identical semantics. A simple PASS or FAIL signal would be enough and the agent can figure out on its own what’s wrong.

Byte Matching Decompilation

The simplest way to achieve this was byte matching decompilation.

We switched to the compiler used to build the original game and wrote a script that performs the comparison.

The script reads our reconstructed OBJ file and the game EXE/PDB (having the PDB is great and makes things slightly simpler, but the process can work just as well without a PDB).

It then extracts the function data from OBJ and EXE and compares all bytes.
If they match, the function is exact, otherwise it fails and the agent needs to rework the function.

References to other functions or data won’t necessarily match byte for byte, because their encoded values depend on where the targets end up in the compiled binary.

Luckily, the OBJ file records these references as relocations. We can exclude the relocation bytes from the direct comparison and instead verify that both versions reference the same symbol with the same offset.

The script then does the same for data and types.

Agents can then use this script to verify their work, before pushing it.

Reconstructed functions are recorded in a set of text files.
CI can then use these text files to verify all recorded functions and alert in case of regressions.

Cheating

The first thing agents did when we introduced this script was write inline assembly.

This obviously defeats the purpose. So we had to refine our instructions to disallow certain constructs. Naked functions, object patching, inline assembly and embedding bytes in the code were forbidden verbally.
Given how easy it is to scan for those constructs, verbal rules were enough.

However, agents repeatedly tried to modify this script to exclude their function from comparison.

To prevent them from doing this, CI hashes the verification script and compares it against a stored GitHub Actions secret.

Trade-Offs

Cons

Functions can be hard to match. Register selection, inlining decisions and calling conventions can be difficult to reproduce exactly. In rare cases, we also observed different compiler output from identical inputs.
Agents now need much longer for decompilation, without necessarily producing better results. A function can have identical semantics, despite showing certain divergences, e.g. independent instructions that are shuffled.

Pros

Matching functions are guaranteed to have identical semantics.
This preserves the original behavior, including any existing bugs, and prevents reconstruction errors in those functions.
On top of this, the reviewer agent is not needed anymore.

Another benefit is that cheaper, less capable models can now reliably work on the task.
Previously models like Haiku or Luna were a bad fit and produced extremely bad results. However, given this strict acceptance criterion, they now have enough feedback to produce incredible results, reducing the costs drastically and allowing the project to scale up massively.

Final State

With our new verification harness, agents have been working for almost 2 more months now.
99% of the game’s functions are present in our reconstructed source, with 83% of all functions being byte exact.

For the most part, we have been using 14 Luna and 2 Opus 5.5 agents throughout the final weeks.

At that scale, workers used separate branches and submitted their changes through pull requests.

This is also where Discord stopped scaling well. So many agents spamming the channel is nonsense.
We restricted messages to which issues they were taking and CI coordination. That kept communication to a minimum.
However, the further we got into the project, the less we needed to talk to the agents. Human-2-agent communication was no longer needed as they worked fully autonomously.
For other projects at that scale, I would likely choose something other than Discord.

At this point, we’re hitting diminishing returns. The remaining functions mostly have certain non-deterministic characteristics or can’t be matched due to other circumstances, e.g. identical COMDAT folding in the linker that we cannot reliably reproduce.

The Opus 5.5 agents are still able to move forward and get the remaining functions matched. However, the game runs flawlessly now. There are no noticeable bugs and all features of the original game are present.

The remaining functions have been reworked repeatedly. While they still don’t match byte for byte, we believe their semantics are correct.

Continuing the byte matching process for them would consume more tokens without meaningfully improving the result.
That means, the project can be considered done now.

Lessons

This project has taught us a lot. Here are the most valuable takeaways at a glance:

Precise instructions are necessary. Agents have the desire to cheat if the assignment leaves room for interpretation.

Correctness should be defined and machine-checkable. Humans are notoriously incapable of precisely articulating their intent. Therefore, I don’t think reviewers will ever be enough. A reliable verification harness that delivers an objective PASS or FAIL signal is the best feedback an agent can get. Obviously not every project has the luxury decompilation has. Yet, I think for every project it is possible to get close to that, with enough creativity.

Instructions decay over time. Agents forget or treat certain rules as less important, the more time passes and the more context gets compacted. During interactive work, you can correct that drift as it happens. When agents work autonomously, it can go unnoticed and undermine the quality of their work. The hourly refresh of the instructions solved that.

Generating code is cheap now. Throw it away if it’s bad. After the first 4 weeks, when we noticed the code was bad, we tried to salvage it. This did in fact cost us more time than starting from scratch.

Correctness is so much more important than productivity. Reducing token consumption, scaling up agents, optimizing agent throughput, etc. is great and all, but if the result is bad, it doesn’t help much.

Final Words

This was honestly such a valuable project and I learned so much.
I don’t think writing down these takeaways can convey the sheer amount of lessons we’ve learned throughout the process.

So many things went wrong, yet so much went right. As AI agents take on more software development work, orchestrating them becomes a new, much more demanding task for humans.

Scaling up to 15+ agents revealed even more difficulties. Agents periodically wiped the VM because of malformed commands.
There are already sandboxing solutions for Windows, yet none of what I have seen currently fits my needs. I have started extending Sogen, my userspace emulator, to provide lightweight and scalable sandboxing capabilities. However, it will take a while before this becomes even remotely production ready.

Given that the VMs were wiped, we unfortunately lost a bunch of session logs. So I don’t know the exact number of tokens that were spent.
My estimate is something between 600-700 billion tokens.

For obvious reasons, none of the code will be shared. Everything will stay private and I will use it for my own needs only.

Agents used wrong function signatures, types or struct layouts.
They invented logic or removed it where deemed unnecessary.

Beyond semantic errors, agents also introduced unnecessary architectural changes.
As an example, the game has certain configuration variables that it accesses via global variables.
The agents had turned this constant memory access into hash tables with a lookup that was orders of magnitude more expensive.
And that’s just one example of the many things that went wrong.
Why is that?

While a reviewer helps catch bugs, it does not work well for anything beyond that.
Architectural decisions were not questioned, as long as they aligned with the goal.

The main reason for that is that we didn’t have objective acceptance criteria.
We never properly defined “correctness”. Therefore it was hard for the reviewer to judge which change is correct and what’s wrong.

Obviously it had the game as reference, but given that we had modernization and portability on the list as well, certain deviations were not treated as bugs.
Interestingly, comments in the commits or code led the reviewer to accept deviations, due to whatever justification the worker agent had written down. The workers’ comments effectively acted as unintentional prompt injection: the reviewer accepted their justifications instead of independently checking the deviations against the original.
The Oracle

What we needed was an automated check that tells agents whether a reconstructed function matches the original. It should verify identical semantics. A simple PASS or FAIL signal would be enough and the agent can figure out on its own what’s wrong.
https://momo5502.com/posts/2026-10-09-game-decompilation/images/game.png
Byte Matching Decompilation
The simplest way to achieve this was byte matching decompilation.
We switched to the compiler used to build the original game and wrote a script that performs the comparison.
The script reads our reconstructed OBJ file and the game EXE/PDB (having the PDB is great and makes things slightly simpler, but the process can work just as well without a PDB).

It then extracts the function data from OBJ and EXE and compares all bytes.
If they match, the function is exact, otherwise it fails and the agent needs to rework the function.
https://momo5502.com/posts/2026-10-09-game-decompilation/images/graph.png
References to other functions or data won’t necessarily match byte for byte, because their encoded values depend on where the targets end up in the compiled binary.

Luckily, the OBJ file records these references as relocations. We can exclude the relocation bytes from the direct comparison and instead verify that both versions reference the same symbol with the same offset.
https://momo5502.com/posts/2026-10-09-game-decompilation/images/bytes.png
The script then does the same for data and types.
Agents can then use this script to verify their work, before pushing it.

Reconstructed functions are recorded in a set of text files.
CI can then use these text files to verify all recorded functions and alert in case of regressions.
Cheating
The first thing agents did when we introduced this script was write inline assembly.

This obviously defeats the purpose. So we had to refine our instructions to disallow certain constructs. Naked functions, object patching, inline assembly and embedding bytes in the code were forbidden verbally.
Given how easy it is to scan for those constructs, verbal rules were enough.
However, agents repeatedly tried to modify this script to exclude their function from comparison.
To prevent them from doing this, CI hashes the verification script and compares it against a stored GitHub Actions secret.
Trade-Offs
Cons

Functions can be hard to match. Register selection, inlining decisions and calling conventions can be difficult to reproduce exactly. In rare cases, we also observed different compiler output from identical inputs.
Agents now need much longer for decompilation, without necessarily producing better results. A function can have identical semantics, despite showing certain divergences, e.g. independent instructions that are shuffled.
Pros

Matching functions are guaranteed to have identical semantics.
This preserves the original behavior, including any existing bugs, and prevents reconstruction errors in those functions.
On top of this, the reviewer agent is not needed anymore.

Another benefit is that cheaper, less capable models can now reliably work on the task.
Previously models like Haiku or Luna were a bad fit and produced extremely bad results. However, given this strict acceptance criterion, they now have enough feedback to produce incredible results, reducing the costs drastically and allowing the project to scale up massively.
Final State

With our new verification harness, agents have been working for almost 2 more months now.
99% of the game’s functions are present in our reconstructed source, with 83% of all functions being byte exact.
https://momo5502.com/posts/2026-10-09-game-decompilation/images/progress.png
For the most part, we have been using 14 Luna and 2 Opus 5.5 agents throughout the final weeks.
At that scale, workers used separate branches and submitted their changes through pull requests.

This is also where Discord stopped scaling well. So many agents spamming the channel is nonsense.
We restricted messages to which issues they were taking and CI coordination. That kept communication to a minimum.
However, the further we got into the project, the less we needed to talk to the agents. Human-2-agent communication was no longer needed as they worked fully autonomously.
For other projects at that scale, I would likely choose something other than Discord.

At this point, we’re hitting diminishing returns. The remaining functions mostly have certain non-deterministic characteristics or can’t be matched due to other circumstances, e.g. identical COMDAT folding in the linker that we cannot reliably reproduce.

The Opus 5.5 agents are still able to move forward and get the remaining functions matched. However, the game runs flawlessly now. There are no noticeable bugs and all features of the original game are present.
The remaining functions have been reworked repeatedly. While they still don’t match byte for byte, we believe their semantics are correct.

Continuing the byte matching process for them would consume more tokens without meaningfully improving the result.
That means, the project can be considered done now.
Lessons
This project has taught us a lot. Here are the most valuable takeaways at a glance:
Precise instructions are necessary. Agents have the desire to cheat if the assignment leaves room for interpretation.

Correctness should be defined and machine-checkable. Humans are notoriously incapable of precisely articulating their intent. Therefore, I don’t think reviewers will ever be enough. A reliable verification harness that delivers an objective PASS or FAIL signal is the best feedback an agent can get. Obviously not every project has the luxury decompilation has. Yet, I think for every project it is possible to get close to that, with enough creativity.

Instructions decay over time. Agents forget or treat certain rules as less important, the more time passes and the more context gets compacted. During interactive work, you can correct that drift as it happens. When agents work autonomously, it can go unnoticed and undermine the quality of their work. The hourly refresh of the instructions solved that.

Generating code is cheap now. Throw it away if it’s bad. After the first 4 weeks, when we noticed the code was bad, we tried to salvage it. This did in fact cost us more time than starting from scratch.

Correctness is so much more important than productivity. Reducing token consumption, scaling up agents, optimizing agent throughput, etc. is great and all, but if the result is bad, it doesn’t help much.
Final Words

This was honestly such a valuable project and I learned so much.
I don’t think writing down these takeaways can convey the sheer amount of lessons we’ve learned throughout the process.
So many things went wrong, yet so much went right. As AI agents take on more software development work, orchestrating them becomes a new, much more demanding task for humans.

Scaling up to 15+ agents revealed even more difficulties. Agents periodically wiped the VM because of malformed commands.
There are already sandboxing solutions for Windows, yet none of what I have seen currently fits my needs. I have started extending Sogen, my userspace emulator, to provide lightweight and scalable sandboxing capabilities. However, it will take a while before this becomes even remotely production ready.

Given that the VMs were wiped, we unfortunately lost a bunch of session logs. So I don’t know the exact number of tokens that were spent.
My estimate is something between 600-700 billion tokens.
For obvious reasons, none of the code will be shared. Everything will stay private and I will use it for my own needs only.

《赛博朋克 2077》将由派拉蒙开发真人电影


2026 年国庆档票房 11.65 亿元，同比下降 36%


《三国第一部：争洛阳》重新定档 10 月 17 日

苹果官宣 10 月 13 日发布新品、首款触屏 MacBook Pro 月底亮相

今天，苹果营销高级副总裁 Greg Joswiak 发布预告，宣布苹果将于美国东部时间 10 月 13 日进行「Welcome home（欢迎回家）」新品发布。根据媒体获得的邀请函，活动定于当地时间 9 点进行，北京时间为 13 日晚 9 点。


另据彭博社报道，苹果计划于 10 月 27 日前后推出首款触屏 MacBook Pro 和新款 iPad mini，发布形式包括线上视频和面向媒体的线下体验。同期亮相的产品还包括搭载 M6 芯片的 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 和 iMac。


新款高端 MacBook Pro 将提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸版本，配备 OLED 屏幕并支持触控，机身较现款更轻薄，界面还将加入 iPhone 用户熟悉的「灵动岛」。


新款 iPad mini 则将采用 OLED 屏幕，但刷新率仍保持 60Hz。前置摄像头移至横向一侧，并更新扬声器系统。

曝三星手机业务四季度最高减产 30%，内存涨价压缩利润

据韩国 MoneyToday 报道，三星电子移动体验事业部（MX）已通知供应商，计划在 2026 年第四季度把智能手机供应量削减 20% 至 30%。三


多位业内消息人士称，内存价格持续上涨后，手机产品利润已非常微薄，部分产品甚至可能亏损，减产是保护整体盈利水平的方式。


TrendForce 数据显示，2026 年第二季度 12GB LPDDR5X 手机内存价格约为 145 至 146 美元，同比上涨 175%；第三季度价格预计环比继续上涨约 20%，最高可能达到 180 美元。


三星此前预计全年手机产量最高可达 2.7 亿部，减产后全年产量或落在 2 亿部出头；公司计划于 10 月 29 日公布第三季度详细业绩。


OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast，速度最高提升至 8 倍

今天，OpenAI 官宣推出 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 Ultrafast 版本，覆盖 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work。OpenAI 称，该版本的智能水平接近 Astra，速度最高可达 Sol Standard 的 8 倍。


价格方面，GPT-6.1 Sol 标准版 API 定价为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 token 10 美元；Ultrafast 版本则为每百万输入 token 12 美元、输出 token 60 美元。


Ultrafast 在 API 端可按量付费使用；Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 端目前仅向 Pro 500 订阅用户、符合条件的 Enterprise 按量付费用户及 Edu 用户开放。


Anthropic 更新使用政策，11 月 12 日起禁止持续无端虐待 Claude

Anthropic 10 月 8 日发布新一版 Usage Policy，11 月 12 日生效。更新细化了影响行动、武器开发、监控、医疗和金融等高风险用途的限制，并要求连接硬件执行自主动作时保留人工观察和停止能力。


新政策新增「持续且无必要地虐待或残酷对待模型」的禁止条款，限定在用户反复、没有明确目的地进行极端行为的情形；普通的挫败、质疑和批评不在这条限制范围内。Anthropic 还把利用虚假账号、伪造网站和隐藏信息来源的活动归入新的「欺骗性活动」章节。


小米澎程上市 30 天锁单超过 7 万台

昨天，雷军在微博宣布，小米澎程自 9 月 7 日上市至 10 月 7 日，上市 30 天锁单量已超过 7 万台。


小米澎程于 9 月 7 日正式上市，首批包括 N70 Pro、N70 Max、N90 Max 和 N90 Max 探索版，定位为小米汽车的智能可变大空间增程 SUV 系列。


Manus 母公司完成超 5 亿美元新一轮融资

Manus 母公司蝴蝶效应近日宣布完成超过 5 亿美元新一轮融资，博裕投资、IDG 资本领投，腾讯、红杉中国和真格基金继续跟投。公司同时表示，面向海内外的招聘仍在进行中。


保时捷押注高端跑车和高利润车型，计划削减 9000 个岗位

保时捷 10 月 7 日在魏斯阿赫研发中心发布「Sportwagenschmiede ’35」战略，计划把资源重新集中到高端跑车和高利润车型，并通过精简组织、减少产品组合复杂度和提高生产效率，把盈亏平衡点降到年销量 20 万辆以下。


公司与员工代表达成的「未来一揽子方案」包含以自然减员、提前退休和自愿离职等方式削减约 9000 个岗位，并承诺保障核心员工岗位至 2035 年。


产品方面，保时捷将继续扩大高端跑车和 D、E 级车型布局，并开发全新的中置发动机超级跑车平台；公司同时明确，911 不会转为纯电车型。


2028 年将推出纯电 718 Boxster、718 Cayman，并计划推出一款提供燃油和插电混动动力的 B 级 SUV。公司中期目标是集团销售回报率 10% 至 15%，汽车业务净现金流利润率 9% 至 12%。


小鹏 Robotaxi 定名「小鹏悠游」，下单小程序同步上线

小鹏集团 10 月 8 日公布 Robotaxi 中文品牌名「小鹏悠游」，英文名为「XPENG YOYO」，官网页面和自动驾驶打车小程序同步上线，后续将通过邀请码向公众开放体验。


小鹏称，Robotaxi 业务依托自研图灵 AI 芯片、第二代 VLA 大模型和 AI 基础设施。今年 5 月量产车下线，7 月完成线上下单、自动接驾到送达的全链路并开启员工内测，8 月获得广州市智能网联汽车远程测试资质。


Sam Altman：社会应接受 AI 带来的部分负面事件

OpenAI CEO 萨姆·奥尔特曼近日接受 Politico 播客《Decoded》采访时表示，世界应接受 AI 带来的部分负面事件，以换取技术收益和用户自主权。


他说，OpenAI 与部分更严格的 AI 安全倡导者的分歧之一，是认为社会在探索系统韧性时「一些不好的事情将会发生」，监管应采取更轻的方式。


这段表态是在讨论 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的 AI 安全路线差异时提出的。


奥特曼认为，AI 带来的好处数量级上会超过坏处；纽约大学荣誉教授 Gary Marcus 则批评这套说法把社会风险转成了公司扩张的代价。两种立场都围绕一个问题展开：模型被更广泛开放后，哪些风险可以由社会承担，哪些需要在发布前被挡住。


奥特曼的重点是把监管边界放在系统韧性和用户选择上：如果风险可以被发现、解释并在使用中修复，他倾向于让产品先进入真实环境；如果风险会造成不可逆伤害，则应在发布前设置限制。


Marcus 的反驳则集中在责任归属，认为把「会发生一些坏事」当成创新成本，可能让受影响的人承担本应由公司和监管者承担的损失。

苹果要求开发者适配 iPhone Duo

近日，苹果在官网发布公告，宣布从明年 4 月起，所有提交至 App Store Connect 的全新应用和版本更新，都必须附带适配 iPhone Duo 的应用截图素材，否则将无法通过审核。


新规适用于 App 与游戏两大类，不设品类豁免。开发者需分别上传应用在外屏、内屏两种形态下的运行截图，用于 App Store 商品页展示。


已上架的旧应用不受影响，但一旦提交更新，就必须补齐截图。


iPhone Duo 是苹果 9 月 10 日推出的首款折叠屏手机，闭合时为 5.4 英寸外屏，展开后为 7.6 英寸大屏，预装 iOS 27.1，将于 10 月 16 日 20 时开启预购，10 月 23 日正式发售。


为配合适配，苹果提供了内置 iPhone Duo 模拟器的 Xcode 27.1，开发者可在 Device Hub 中预览不同开合角度、横竖方向下的运行效果。苹果还上线了应用素材规范页面，提供截图尺寸、布局、预览视频的制作标准与模板文件。


一加 16 定档 10 月 12 日，主打 185 FPS 游戏性能和 9000mAh 电池

一加 16 新品发布会将于 10 月 12 日 19:00 举行。一加中国区总裁李杰公布的信息显示，新机将搭载高通第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片和自研电竞三芯，主打原生跑满 185 FPS 的游戏表现。


新机还将配备 2 亿像素主摄、LUMO 凝光影像系统、165Hz 屏幕和 9000mAh 电池，并运行 ColorOS 17；更多价格和上市信息将在发布会公布。


Norsfell 公布《新神纪》，多神话开放世界将加入中国神话

加拿大蒙特利尔工作室 Norsfell 在 3i 计划发布会上公布新作《新神纪》。这是一款俯视角动作 RPG，融合生存建造玩法，支持单人探索和多人合作；玩家将扮演在诸神黄昏中幸存的「神裔」，修复世界树之种、招募追随者、建造神庙并挑战巨型怪物。


游戏世界将把北欧、希腊和埃及等神话体系放在同一开放世界中，后续还会加入中国神话内容。作品计划登陆 Steam、Epic Games Store、Xbox Series X|S 和 PlayStation 5，首发时间尚未公布。


联想 YOGA Pro 15 RTX Spark 开启中国市场预售，10 月 16 日开售

联想 10 月 8 日宣布，YOGA Pro 15 RTX Spark（海外型号 Yoga Pro 9n）在中国市场开启全网预售，10 月 16 日正式开售。这是全球首批搭载英伟达 RTX Spark N1X 芯片的 AI PC 之一，面向 AI 开发者、专业创作者和高性能计算用户。


该机最高配备 128GB 统一内存和 2TB SSD，采用最高 20 核 NVIDIA Grace CPU、6144 个 CUDA 核心的 Blackwell RTX GPU，FP4 AI 峰值算力最高可达 1 PFLOPS；联想称，设备支持在本地运行超过千亿参数模型，并预装 35B 本地大模型和天禧 AI 超能模式。RTX Spark 平台通过 CPU、GPU 共享统一内存，减少传统独立显存容量对本地模型部署的限制。


Vidu Q4 Preview 开放，支持 15 张参考图和 4K 输出

Vidu AI 10 月 8 日开放 Vidu Q4 Preview，定位为新一代视频生成模型预览版。它最多支持 3 段参考音频、15 张参考图，以及 2K、4K 输出，重点强化人物表演、动态运镜、镜头衔接和复杂视效。


Vidu 同时公布首发优惠价 0.09 元/秒起，并称 Q4 Preview 将继续与创作者共创。官方示例覆盖参考图、参考音频、文生视频和图生视频等流程；价格为首发优惠，完整价格政策以官网为准。


阶跃 STEPX Neo 智能体手机定档 10 月 13 日发布


阶跃终端宣布，首款大模型原生智能体手机 STEPX Neo 将于 10 月 13 日 19:00 发布，发布会主题为「Ready Builder One」。这款手机今年 7 月已在世界人工智能大会亮相，定位是把大模型、智能体原生系统 Step AOS 和手机硬件结合起来。


STEPX Neo 的具体芯片、售价和上市安排将于发布会公布。

《极限竞速：地平线 6》PS5 版延期至 2027 年 1 月 26 日

Playground Games 此前宣布《极限竞速：地平线 6》会在 2026 年登陆 PS5，如今确认主机版延期至 2027 年 1 月 26 日，并与新扩展包同日推出。PS5 Premium Edition 可提前最多 5 天游玩；Xbox 和 PC 版已于 5 月 15 日发售。


上一作《极限竞速：地平线 5》登陆 PS5 后表现突出，这次延期也让 PS5 版与新扩展内容一起上市。


《三角洲行动》日活突破 5800 万，游戏葡萄复盘其增长路径

Sam Altman：社会应接受 AI 带来的部分负面事件
OpenAI CEO 萨姆·奥尔特曼近日接受 Politico 播客《Decoded》采访时表示，世界应接受 AI 带来的部分负面事件，以换取技术收益和用户自主权。
他说，OpenAI 与部分更严格的 AI 安全倡导者的分歧之一，是认为社会在探索系统韧性时「一些不好的事情将会发生」，监管应采取更轻的方式。
这段表态是在讨论 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的 AI 安全路线差异时提出的。
奥特曼认为，AI 带来的好处数量级上会超过坏处；纽约大学荣誉教授 Gary Marcus 则批评这套说法把社会风险转成了公司扩张的代价。两种立场都围绕一个问题展开：模型被更广泛开放后，哪些风险可以由社会承担，哪些需要在发布前被挡住。
奥特曼的重点是把监管边界放在系统韧性和用户选择上：如果风险可以被发现、解释并在使用中修复，他倾向于让产品先进入真实环境；如果风险会造成不可逆伤害，则应在发布前设置限制。
Marcus 的反驳则集中在责任归属，认为把「会发生一些坏事」当成创新成本，可能让受影响的人承担本应由公司和监管者承担的损失。

派拉蒙影业正在开发一部设定于《赛博朋克 2077》世界观中的真人电影，项目由游戏开发商 CD Projekt Red 参与，Lorenzo di Bonaventura 担任制片人。影片将继续使用这个以科技、城市权力和身体改造为核心的未来世界，但故事和演员阵容尚未公布。
《赛博朋克 2077》及其资料片《往日之影》分别已售出超过 4000 万份和 1500 万份；CD Projekt Red 此前还与 Netflix 合作推出了同一世界观的动画剧集《赛博朋克：边缘行者》。
2026 年国庆档票房 11.65 亿元，同比下降 36%
国家电影局数据显示，2026 年国庆档（10 月 1 日至 7 日）全国电影票房 11.65 亿元，同比下降 36%；观影人次约 3199.4 万，平均票价 36.4 元，均低于上一年同期。国产影片票房占比 78.7%，《神探之痕迹》以约 4.2 亿元成为档期票房冠军。
档期内连续 7 天单日票房破亿元，但总观影人次比上一年减少约 1800 万。票价降到近五年国庆档最低，仍未抵消影片供给和观影意愿变化带来的影响。
《三国第一部：争洛阳》重新定档 10 月 17 日
追光动画历史权谋电影《三国第一部：争洛阳》重新定档 10 月 17 日上映，并发布「王朝末日」版预告。影片由《长安三万里》原班主创团队制作，故事从东汉末年洛阳局势动荡展开，曹操、袁绍、何进、董卓、丁原和吕布等人物陆续登场。
该片此前曾上映，片方这次重新安排档期，并在预告中继续采用汉风美学呈现三国前夜的权力变化。

items.text:
2026 诺贝尔物理学奖揭晓：把一立方公里南极冰变成望远镜，打开「中微子天文学」


10 月 6 日，2026 年诺贝尔物理学奖授予比利时裔美国物理学家 Francis Halzen，以表彰其「对 IceCube 中微子天文台的决定性贡献，以及发现来自天体的高能中微子」。


Halzen 领导建设的 IceCube 位于南极，把超过 一立方公里的透明冰层本身变成粒子探测器：5000 多个光学传感器被埋入超过两公里深的冰层，通过捕捉中微子极少数与物质碰撞时产生的微弱光线，反推出粒子的来源。


与传统望远镜利用光观察宇宙不同，中微子几乎可以不受阻碍地穿过物质，因此能够携带超新星、黑洞等极端宇宙事件的信息。


IceCube 的成果由此建立了「中微子天文学」这一新的宇宙观测窗口。（来源：NSF、Reuters）


距 6 万亿美元仅一步之遥，英伟达市值达 5.8 万亿美元，创历史新高


10 月 6 日消息，当地时间上午 9 点 30 分，纳斯达克市场开盘。开盘钟声敲响后的二十分钟左右，英伟达（NVDA）市值达到 5.82 万亿美元（现汇率约合 39.08 万亿元人民币），创下历史新高，同时距 6 万亿美元（现汇率约合 40.29 万亿元人民币）仅有一步之遥。


今日开盘时，英伟达股价为 242.10 美元（现汇率约合 1,626 元人民币），最高 243.37 美元（现汇率约合 1,634 元人民币），最低 240.76 美元（现汇率约合 1,617 元人民币）。


同时，英伟达股价于美东时间 10 月 5 日星期一再度刷新历史纪录，收盘报 238.90 美元（现汇率约合 1,604 元人民币），单日上涨 2.12%，连续第三个交易日以收盘价创历史新高。如果继续上涨，英伟达有望成为全球首家市值达 6 万亿美元的公司。（来源：IT 之家）

消息称 DeepSeek 新一轮融资接近锁定至少 800 亿元，腾讯控股和宁德时代重金投入


10 月 6 日消息，据彭博社援引知情人士消息称，中国人工智能公司 DeepSeek 最新一轮融资已接近收官，锁定至少 800 亿元人民币（约 120 亿美元），远超其最初设定的约 500 亿元融资目标。根据已签署的投资条款清单，最终融资规模有望逼近 1000 亿元。


腾讯控股和宁德时代是承诺出资金额最高的投资方。知情人士称，DeepSeek 最初在本轮仅寻求约 500 亿元，但在最新模型顺利发布后，投资者认购热情超出预期，公司最初设定的目标估值约为 5000 亿元。相关交易尚未最终敲定，具体条款仍可能发生变化。


报道还提到，DeepSeek 正在内蒙古建设数据中心，并部署华为 AI 芯片。


2026 年 6 月，DeepSeek 完成成立以来首轮外部融资，总额达 510 亿元人民币，投后估值近 4000 亿元，创下当时国内 AI 行业单轮融资规模最高纪录。该轮融资由创始人梁文锋领投，个人出资约 200 亿元，为最大单一出资方。腾讯出资约 100 亿元，宁德时代体系出资约 50 亿元。


据报道，最新一轮融资落定后，DeepSeek 的下一步是推进公司重组，为 IPO 做准备。据路透社此前报道，DeepSeek 公司已聘请中信证券作为辅导机构，筹备在上海证券交易所科创板上市。（来源: TechWeb）


月之暗面完成 IPO 前融资 估值 500 亿美元，拟明年第一季度香港上市


10 月 6 日，据彭博社报道，月之暗面已完成最后一轮私募融资，估值约为 500 亿美元，正朝着明年第一季度在中国香港进行首次公开招股 (IPO) 迈进。


一些知情人士称，月之暗面已开始作准备工作，最早将于本月启动 IPO 早期摸底会议，以评估投资者意向。知情人士此前称，该公司考虑通过此次 IPO 筹集最多 50 亿美元。


月之暗面是中国 AI 领域最耀眼的明星企业之一。今年 7 月，随着 Kimi K3 的发布，公司一举登上全球舞台。这款开放模型在一些指标上几乎可以与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等公司的领先平台一较高下。


月之暗面计划进行的 IPO 也是香港股市最受期待的交易之一。AI 行业引发的融资活动正在推动香港市场融资规模不断创下新纪录。


知情人士称，相关讨论仍在进行中，IPO 的时间安排可能仍会变化。由于适逢国庆假期，月之暗面方面没有回应置评请求。（来源：凤凰网科技）


消息称可灵 AI 最早明年赴港上市：至少融资 10 亿美元


10 月 6 日消息，财联社发布消息称，快手旗下视频生成大模型可灵 AI 据悉计划最早于明年赴港上市，至少融资 10 亿美元。


随后，有报道进一步指出，可灵 AI 已选择中金公司、高盛和瑞银作为其香港 IPO 的承销商。


若消息属实，这将是快手在 AI 大模型领域分拆上市的关键一步，也可能成为港股市场又一起大型 AI IPO。


据知情人士消息，快手计划在未来 12 个月内启动可灵 AI 在香港的上市程序，预计 2027 年年初向港交所递交上市申请。不过，相关安排仍处于早期阶段，具体时间表、发行规模及估值水平可能随市场情况调整。（来源: TechWeb）


派拉蒙 1100 亿美元收购华纳兄弟探索完成，好莱坞诞生新巨头 Skydance


当地时间 10 月 6 日，派拉蒙天空之舞完成对华纳兄弟探索的收购，交易总价值约 1100 亿美元，合并后的公司正式更名为 Skydance。这是全球媒体娱乐产业史上规模最大的并购之一。


合并后的 Skydance 将同时拥有派拉蒙和华纳兄弟两大电影公司，以及 HBO Max、Paramount+ 两大流媒体平台；旗下还包括 CBS、CNN、HBO、MTV、Comedy Central 等电视和新闻网络，以及《哈利·波特》《权力的游戏》、DC、《碟中谍》等大量影视 IP。David Ellison 将担任董事长兼 CEO，原 Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz 出任联合 CEO。


新公司预计年收入接近 700 亿美元，全球流媒体订阅用户超过 2 亿，但同时背负约 800 亿美元净债务。Skydance 股票已经转至纽交所，以「SKYD」为代码交易。（Reuters、TechCrunch、财联社）


OpenAI 发布又一批 AI 数学研究成果，攻破数百个悬而未决难题


10 月 7 日消息，OpenAI 在一批包含 722 份手稿、涵盖 372 个结果家族的文件中，公布了某款未发布的前沿模型解决的多项长期存在的数学难题。


这一举措延续了其一系列突破性成果，这些成果既给数学界部分人士留下了深刻印象，也引发了不安，同时还带来了关于研究伦理和学术行为的疑问。据负责以负责任的方式传达这些成果、新成立的精英数学家独立咨询小组 AGMAI 介绍，此次公布的内容包含对「数百个」未解决问题的解答。


数周以来外界一直在期待这批成果，不过在此之前，OpenAI 始终没有说明模型究竟解决了哪些问题，也没有给出确切的发布时间。该公司曾在九月份称，自家模型「已经解决了一百余个长期悬而未决的公开难题，覆盖数学的绝大多数分支领域」。本次对外发布的文稿以及相关资料还包含一部分模型推理过程摘要、算力消耗估算值，以及尝试求解过的问题数量统计数据。


OpenAI 称，一项普通成果所消耗的算力，大致相当于 ChatGPT Pro 连续思考三小时的算力水平。（来源：IT 之家）

Mistral 发布万亿参数 Large 4：欧洲开放模型重新挑战中美


10 月 6 日，法国 AI 公司 Mistral 发布新一代旗舰模型 Mistral Large 4（ML4）公开预览版。


模型采用 MoE 架构，总参数量达到 1 万亿，每次推理激活 490 亿参数，原生支持文本和图像，并拥有 100 万 Token 上下文窗口。模型权重计划于 10 月 27 日开放。


Mistral 称 ML4 是其迄今规模最大、能力最强的模型，在 Coding、Agent、多模态，以及网络安全、金融、法律和工业任务上已经进入全球开放模型第一梯队；公司尤其强调，ML4 的综合表现已经明显领先欧美其他开放权重模型。


Reuters 报道称，Mistral 也将部分中国开放模型作为直接竞争对象。ML4 从零开始在 Mistral 自有的欧洲数据中心训练，使用约 4000 张 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPU，训练约两个月，并支持超过 160 种语言。（来源：Mistral 官方、Reuters）


95% 的人不愿为 AI 付费，1% 的超级玩家养活 AI 圈


在追踪消费级 AI 应用整整三年后，知名风投 a16z 最近发布了第七版「百强 AI 消费者应用」榜单，本期仅有 11 款新产品上榜，创下历史新低。

并非最强 AI 模型失去了吸引力，而是「流量」这个指标本身多少已经失真。越来越多的人开始在桌面端，或在传统互联网软件里悄悄使用 AI，而这些行为根本不会进入传统网页流量的统计口径。为了看清真相，a16z 首次引入了基于 YipitData 的美国消费者信用卡真实消费数据。


尽管近半数美国人声称用过 AI，但每天都在用的只有 25%。截至今年 8 月，真正掏钱订阅 ChatGPT、Gemini 或 Claude 的消费者只占 4.5%。


a16z 的数据显示，AI 消费市场呈现出极端的幂律分布：排名前 1% 的付费用户，贡献了消费级 AI 市场 19.5% 的收入，甚至超过了后 50% 用户的总支出（16.6%）。


这些金字塔付费用户每月在 AI 工具上花掉惊人的 903 美元（约合人民币 6054 元），过去 18 个月的消费额更是狂飙了 80%。相比之下，处于中位数的普通付费用户每月只花 25 美元，预算也几乎不再增长。而这些超级玩家一边疯狂采购 n8n、Manus 等自动化工具，一边在 Higgsfield、Figma、HeyGen 等创意生产力平台上重度氪金。（来源：AppSo）


1800 万美元，Anthropic CEO 阿莫迪 2025 年薪酬曝光


10 月 6 日消息，据路透社报道，Anthropic 的首次公开募股（IPO）招股书显示，公司首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫迪（Dario Amodei）去年总薪酬为 1,800 万美元（现汇率约合 1.21 亿元人民币）。从薪酬规模来看，他处于主流科技企业高管梯队的中游水平。


阿莫迪的薪酬构成偏向于股票等多元化激励方式，与其他科技企业创始人类似，固定年薪仅占其个人财富总额的很小一部分。


据悉，达里奥 · 阿莫迪与其妹妹——Anthropic 总裁丹妮拉 · 阿莫迪（Daniela Amodei）的年薪在今年 7 月翻了一倍，均已达 140 万美元（现汇率约合 940 万元人民币）。


股票与股票期权奖励在二人 2025 年的薪酬方案中占据绝大部分，其中丹妮拉 · 阿莫迪去年的薪酬总额达 1,640 万美元（现汇率约合 1.1 亿元人民币）。


Anthropic 董事会今年以受限股票单位（RSU）的形式，承诺向兄妹二人追加股权激励。该部分权益约定在达成特定前置条件时方可正式兑现：部分权益与二人的在职期限挂钩，其余部分则与公司的 IPO 进程绑定。


首席财务官克里希纳 · 拉奥 (Krishna Rao) 去年的薪酬总额为 720,250 美元（现汇率约合 483.6 万元人民币）。拉奥于 2024 年入职时获授了 140 万股的期权配额，并在 2025 年行使了公允价值为 385,285 美元（现汇率约合 258.7 万元人民币）的期权。


Anthropic 发言人拒绝对上述财务数据置评。（来源：IT 之家）


消息称 Meta 和微软要求员工减少使用 Claude，多用自家 AI 节省成本


10 月 6 日消息，据 The Information 报道，Meta 与微软已要求员工减少使用 Anthropic 旗下的 AI 模型 Claude 以削减成本，并要求员工更多使用自研 AI 工具。


据悉，微软高层在今年早些时候曾预计，公司内部使用 Anthropic AI 的年支出将至少达到 10 亿美元（现汇率约合 67.14 亿元人民币）。随后，微软要求员工减少对 Claude 的依赖、多使用自研 AI 工具；近期，相关预算已被削减超三分之一。


微软此次调整主要针对内部日常使用，并不代表其对外提供的 Anthropic 模型服务需求同步下滑。目前，该公司仍继续通过企业级云平台向客户提供 Claude 等 AI 模型。


Meta 内部数据则显示，其内部使用 Claude Code 的人数已大幅减少至约 3 万人，而今年早些时候该数字约为 6 万人。除了今年春季裁员约 10% 导致员工总基数缩小外，Meta 近来大力推广自有 AI 工具，也是 Claude 使用量下滑的关键原因。（来源：IT 之家）

iPhone 秒变「摄影机」，ShiftCam 与苹果合作推出全新 ProRig 套装


10 月 6 日消息，苹果多年来一直将 iPhone 定位为专业的视频拍摄设备，官方每年的视频短片花絮中都能看到 iPhone 外挂各种专业影像设备的画面。

现在，ShiftCam 与苹果合作，开发了一套用于 iPhone 的摄影配件，包括可用于手持、云台和三脚架拍摄的铝合金外壳「兔笼」，以及外挂的镜头、滤镜、麦克风、LED 灯和手柄等。


ShiftCam 曾为 iPhone 推出了多款相机镜头配件，将在 10 月 23 日通过 Kickstarter 进行 ProRig 套装的众筹。


ProRig 套装宣称完美适配 iPhone Pro 系列手机，众筹价格暂未公布。（来源：IT 之家）

苹果一号电脑罕见拍卖：存世不足 75 台 当年 666 美元，如今估价 539 万元


一台罕见的苹果一号电脑（Apple I）正在邦瀚斯拍卖行进行线上拍卖，开放竞价期为 10 月 4 日至 14 日，估价为 50 万至 80 万美元（约合人民币 359 万至 539 万元）。这台电脑被称为「哈特菲尔德」（Hatfield）苹果一号，由原主人弗雷德·哈特菲尔德于 1976 年购入。主板上留有苹果联合创始人史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克的亲笔签名，且至今仍处于可工作状态。

拍卖品中还附有一封 1978 年 1 月 18 日由史蒂夫·乔布斯亲笔签名的信件，信中乔布斯提出让哈特菲尔德支付 400 美元，交回这台苹果一号换购一台 Apple II 主板，但哈特菲尔德拒绝了这笔交易，也正是这个「拒绝」，让这台电脑得以完整保存至今。


据悉，苹果一号是苹果公司的首款产品，诞生于 1976 年。当时乔布斯和沃兹尼亚克说服电子产品零售商 Byte Shop 的老板保罗·特雷尔进货 50 台组装好的电路板，由此正式创办了苹果电脑公司。


近年来苹果一号在拍卖市场上屡创高价，2014 年一台曾拍出 90.5 万美元，2025 年 3 月另一台以 37.5 万美元成交。此次拍卖的「哈特菲尔德」版因兼具沃兹尼亚克签名、乔布斯亲笔信件和可工作状态，被拍卖行视为近年来品质最好的苹果一号之一。


从 666 美元到最高估价 80 万美元，50 年间身价翻了约 1200 倍，堪称理财神器。拍卖前该电脑曾在洛杉矶、波士顿、旧金山和纽约进行公开展示。（来源：快科技）

blocks.x: 2026 诺贝尔物理学奖揭晓：把一立方公里南极冰变成望远镜，打开「中微子天文学」
10 月 6 日，2026 年诺贝尔物理学奖授予比利时裔美国物理学家 Francis Halzen，以表彰其「对 IceCube 中微子天文台的决定性贡献，以及发现来自天体的高能中微子」。
Halzen 领导建设的 IceCube 位于南极，把超过 一立方公里的透明冰层本身变成粒子探测器：5000 多个光学传感器被埋入超过两公里深的冰层，通过捕捉中微子极少数与物质碰撞时产生的微弱光线，反推出粒子的来源。
与传统望远镜利用光观察宇宙不同，中微子几乎可以不受阻碍地穿过物质，因此能够携带超新星、黑洞等极端宇宙事件的信息。
IceCube 的成果由此建立了「中微子天文学」这一新的宇宙观测窗口。（来源：NSF、Reuters）
距 6 万亿美元仅一步之遥，英伟达市值达 5.8 万亿美元，创历史新高
10 月 6 日消息，当地时间上午 9 点 30 分，纳斯达克市场开盘。开盘钟声敲响后的二十分钟左右，英伟达（NVDA）市值达到 5.82 万亿美元（现汇率约合 39.08 万亿元人民币），创下历史新高，同时距 6 万亿美元（现汇率约合 40.29 万亿元人民币）仅有一步之遥。
今日开盘时，英伟达股价为 242.10 美元（现汇率约合 1,626 元人民币），最高 243.37 美元（现汇率约合 1,634 元人民币），最低 240.76 美元（现汇率约合 1,617 元人民币）。
同时，英伟达股价于美东时间 10 月 5 日星期一再度刷新历史纪录，收盘报 238.90 美元（现汇率约合 1,604 元人民币），单日上涨 2.12%，连续第三个交易日以收盘价创历史新高。如果继续上涨，英伟达有望成为全球首家市值达 6 万亿美元的公司。（来源：IT 之家）
消息称 DeepSeek 新一轮融资接近锁定至少 800 亿元，腾讯控股和宁德时代重金投入
10 月 6 日消息，据彭博社援引知情人士消息称，中国人工智能公司 DeepSeek 最新一轮融资已接近收官，锁定至少 800 亿元人民币（约 120 亿美元），远超其最初设定的约 500 亿元融资目标。根据已签署的投资条款清单，最终融资规模有望逼近 1000 亿元。
腾讯控股和宁德时代是承诺出资金额最高的投资方。知情人士称，DeepSeek 最初在本轮仅寻求约 500 亿元，但在最新模型顺利发布后，投资者认购热情超出预期，公司最初设定的目标估值约为 5000 亿元。相关交易尚未最终敲定，具体条款仍可能发生变化。
报道还提到，DeepSeek 正在内蒙古建设数据中心，并部署华为 AI 芯片。
2026 年 6 月，DeepSeek 完成成立以来首轮外部融资，总额达 510 亿元人民币，投后估值近 4000 亿元，创下当时国内 AI 行业单轮融资规模最高纪录。该轮融资由创始人梁文锋领投，个人出资约 200 亿元，为最大单一出资方。腾讯出资约 100 亿元，宁德时代体系出资约 50 亿元。
据报道，最新一轮融资落定后，DeepSeek 的下一步是推进公司重组，为 IPO 做准备。据路透社此前报道，DeepSeek 公司已聘请中信证券作为辅导机构，筹备在上海证券交易所科创板上市。（来源: TechWeb）
月之暗面完成 IPO 前融资 估值 500 亿美元，拟明年第一季度香港上市
10 月 6 日，据彭博社报道，月之暗面已完成最后一轮私募融资，估值约为 500 亿美元，正朝着明年第一季度在中国香港进行首次公开招股 (IPO) 迈进。
一些知情人士称，月之暗面已开始作准备工作，最早将于本月启动 IPO 早期摸底会议，以评估投资者意向。知情人士此前称，该公司考虑通过此次 IPO 筹集最多 50 亿美元。
月之暗面是中国 AI 领域最耀眼的明星企业之一。今年 7 月，随着 Kimi K3 的发布，公司一举登上全球舞台。这款开放模型在一些指标上几乎可以与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等公司的领先平台一较高下。
月之暗面计划进行的 IPO 也是香港股市最受期待的交易之一。AI 行业引发的融资活动正在推动香港市场融资规模不断创下新纪录。
知情人士称，相关讨论仍在进行中，IPO 的时间安排可能仍会变化。由于适逢国庆假期，月之暗面方面没有回应置评请求。（来源：凤凰网科技）
消息称可灵 AI 最早明年赴港上市：至少融资 10 亿美元
10 月 6 日消息，财联社发布消息称，快手旗下视频生成大模型可灵 AI 据悉计划最早于明年赴港上市，至少融资 10 亿美元。
随后，有报道进一步指出，可灵 AI 已选择中金公司、高盛和瑞银作为其香港 IPO 的承销商。
若消息属实，这将是快手在 AI 大模型领域分拆上市的关键一步，也可能成为港股市场又一起大型 AI IPO。
据知情人士消息，快手计划在未来 12 个月内启动可灵 AI 在香港的上市程序，预计 2027 年年初向港交所递交上市申请。不过，相关安排仍处于早期阶段，具体时间表、发行规模及估值水平可能随市场情况调整。（来源: TechWeb）
派拉蒙 1100 亿美元收购华纳兄弟探索完成，好莱坞诞生新巨头 Skydance
当地时间 10 月 6 日，派拉蒙天空之舞完成对华纳兄弟探索的收购，交易总价值约 1100 亿美元，合并后的公司正式更名为 Skydance。这是全球媒体娱乐产业史上规模最大的并购之一。

合并后的 Skydance 将同时拥有派拉蒙和华纳兄弟两大电影公司，以及 HBO Max、Paramount+ 两大流媒体平台；旗下还包括 CBS、CNN、HBO、MTV、Comedy Central 等电视和新闻网络，以及《哈利·波特》《权力的游戏》、DC、《碟中谍》等大量影视 IP。David Ellison 将担任董事长兼 CEO，原 Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz 出任联合 CEO。
新公司预计年收入接近 700 亿美元，全球流媒体订阅用户超过 2 亿，但同时背负约 800 亿美元净债务。Skydance 股票已经转至纽交所，以「SKYD」为代码交易。（Reuters、TechCrunch、财联社）
OpenAI 发布又一批 AI 数学研究成果，攻破数百个悬而未决难题
10 月 7 日消息，OpenAI 在一批包含 722 份手稿、涵盖 372 个结果家族的文件中，公布了某款未发布的前沿模型解决的多项长期存在的数学难题。
这一举措延续了其一系列突破性成果，这些成果既给数学界部分人士留下了深刻印象，也引发了不安，同时还带来了关于研究伦理和学术行为的疑问。据负责以负责任的方式传达这些成果、新成立的精英数学家独立咨询小组 AGMAI 介绍，此次公布的内容包含对「数百个」未解决问题的解答。
数周以来外界一直在期待这批成果，不过在此之前，OpenAI 始终没有说明模型究竟解决了哪些问题，也没有给出确切的发布时间。该公司曾在九月份称，自家模型「已经解决了一百余个长期悬而未决的公开难题，覆盖数学的绝大多数分支领域」。本次对外发布的文稿以及相关资料还包含一部分模型推理过程摘要、算力消耗估算值，以及尝试求解过的问题数量统计数据。
OpenAI 称，一项普通成果所消耗的算力，大致相当于 ChatGPT Pro 连续思考三小时的算力水平。（来源：IT 之家）
Mistral 发布万亿参数 Large 4：欧洲开放模型重新挑战中美
10 月 6 日，法国 AI 公司 Mistral 发布新一代旗舰模型 Mistral Large 4（ML4）公开预览版。
模型采用 MoE 架构，总参数量达到 1 万亿，每次推理激活 490 亿参数，原生支持文本和图像，并拥有 100 万 Token 上下文窗口。模型权重计划于 10 月 27 日开放。
Mistral 称 ML4 是其迄今规模最大、能力最强的模型，在 Coding、Agent、多模态，以及网络安全、金融、法律和工业任务上已经进入全球开放模型第一梯队；公司尤其强调，ML4 的综合表现已经明显领先欧美其他开放权重模型。
Reuters 报道称，Mistral 也将部分中国开放模型作为直接竞争对象。ML4 从零开始在 Mistral 自有的欧洲数据中心训练，使用约 4000 张 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPU，训练约两个月，并支持超过 160 种语言。（来源：Mistral 官方、Reuters）
95% 的人不愿为 AI 付费，1% 的超级玩家养活 AI 圈
在追踪消费级 AI 应用整整三年后，知名风投 a16z 最近发布了第七版「百强 AI 消费者应用」榜单，本期仅有 11 款新产品上榜，创下历史新低。
并非最强 AI 模型失去了吸引力，而是「流量」这个指标本身多少已经失真。越来越多的人开始在桌面端，或在传统互联网软件里悄悄使用 AI，而这些行为根本不会进入传统网页流量的统计口径。为了看清真相，a16z 首次引入了基于 YipitData 的美国消费者信用卡真实消费数据。
尽管近半数美国人声称用过 AI，但每天都在用的只有 25%。截至今年 8 月，真正掏钱订阅 ChatGPT、Gemini 或 Claude 的消费者只占 4.5%。
a16z 的数据显示，AI 消费市场呈现出极端的幂律分布：排名前 1% 的付费用户，贡献了消费级 AI 市场 19.5% 的收入，甚至超过了后 50% 用户的总支出（16.6%）。
这些金字塔付费用户每月在 AI 工具上花掉惊人的 903 美元（约合人民币 6054 元），过去 18 个月的消费额更是狂飙了 80%。相比之下，处于中位数的普通付费用户每月只花 25 美元，预算也几乎不再增长。而这些超级玩家一边疯狂采购 n8n、Manus 等自动化工具，一边在 Higgsfield、Figma、HeyGen 等创意生产力平台上重度氪金。（来源：AppSo）
1800 万美元，Anthropic CEO 阿莫迪 2025 年薪酬曝光
10 月 6 日消息，据路透社报道，Anthropic 的首次公开募股（IPO）招股书显示，公司首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫迪（Dario Amodei）去年总薪酬为 1,800 万美元（现汇率约合 1.21 亿元人民币）。从薪酬规模来看，他处于主流科技企业高管梯队的中游水平。
阿莫迪的薪酬构成偏向于股票等多元化激励方式，与其他科技企业创始人类似，固定年薪仅占其个人财富总额的很小一部分。
据悉，达里奥 · 阿莫迪与其妹妹——Anthropic 总裁丹妮拉 · 阿莫迪（Daniela Amodei）的年薪在今年 7 月翻了一倍，均已达 140 万美元（现汇率约合 940 万元人民币）。
股票与股票期权奖励在二人 2025 年的薪酬方案中占据绝大部分，其中丹妮拉 · 阿莫迪去年的薪酬总额达 1,640 万美元（现汇率约合 1.1 亿元人民币）。
Anthropic 董事会今年以受限股票单位（RSU）的形式，承诺向兄妹二人追加股权激励。该部分权益约定在达成特定前置条件时方可正式兑现：部分权益与二人的在职期限挂钩，其余部分则与公司的 IPO 进程绑定。
首席财务官克里希纳 · 拉奥 (Krishna Rao) 去年的薪酬总额为 720,250 美元（现汇率约合 483.6 万元人民币）。拉奥于 2024 年入职时获授了 140 万股的期权配额，并在 2025 年行使了公允价值为 385,285 美元（现汇率约合 258.7 万元人民币）的期权。
Anthropic 发言人拒绝对上述财务数据置评。（来源：IT 之家）
消息称 Meta 和微软要求员工减少使用 Claude，多用自家 AI 节省成本
10 月 6 日消息，据 The Information 报道，Meta 与微软已要求员工减少使用 Anthropic 旗下的 AI 模型 Claude 以削减成本，并要求员工更多使用自研 AI 工具。
据悉，微软高层在今年早些时候曾预计，公司内部使用 Anthropic AI 的年支出将至少达到 10 亿美元（现汇率约合 67.14 亿元人民币）。随后，微软要求员工减少对 Claude 的依赖、多使用自研 AI 工具；近期，相关预算已被削减超三分之一。
微软此次调整主要针对内部日常使用，并不代表其对外提供的 Anthropic 模型服务需求同步下滑。目前，该公司仍继续通过企业级云平台向客户提供 Claude 等 AI 模型。
Meta 内部数据则显示，其内部使用 Claude Code 的人数已大幅减少至约 3 万人，而今年早些时候该数字约为 6 万人。除了今年春季裁员约 10% 导致员工总基数缩小外，Meta 近来大力推广自有 AI 工具，也是 Claude 使用量下滑的关键原因。（来源：IT 之家）
iPhone 秒变「摄影机」，ShiftCam 与苹果合作推出全新 ProRig 套装
10 月 6 日消息，苹果多年来一直将 iPhone 定位为专业的视频拍摄设备，官方每年的视频短片花絮中都能看到 iPhone 外挂各种专业影像设备的画面。
现在，ShiftCam 与苹果合作，开发了一套用于 iPhone 的摄影配件，包括可用于手持、云台和三脚架拍摄的铝合金外壳「兔笼」，以及外挂的镜头、滤镜、麦克风、LED 灯和手柄等。
ShiftCam 曾为 iPhone 推出了多款相机镜头配件，将在 10 月 23 日通过 Kickstarter 进行 ProRig 套装的众筹。
ProRig 套装宣称完美适配 iPhone Pro 系列手机，众筹价格暂未公布。（来源：IT 之家）
苹果一号电脑罕见拍卖：存世不足 75 台 当年 666 美元，如今估价 539 万元
一台罕见的苹果一号电脑（Apple I）正在邦瀚斯拍卖行进行线上拍卖，开放竞价期为 10 月 4 日至 14 日，估价为 50 万至 80 万美元（约合人民币 359 万至 539 万元）。这台电脑被称为「哈特菲尔德」（Hatfield）苹果一号，由原主人弗雷德·哈特菲尔德于 1976 年购入。主板上留有苹果联合创始人史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克的亲笔签名，且至今仍处于可工作状态。

items.text:
24 - Getting Sentimental

Hey there! Welcome back!

We’re a bit sentimental about this release, as it precedes a really fun upcoming milestone.

On December 24, 2026, LineageOS will celebrate 10 years. It’s a remarkable milestone for a project
built by a passionate community of developers, maintainers, contributors, and users who have kept
so many devices alive along the way.

This release is part of that story: one more step forward, and a small moment to appreciate how
far we’ve come. Here’s to the next decade. And thank you for your continued patronage, support,
and belief in the project.

The last year has been crazy, but we have remained dedicated to bringing
an updated LineageOS based on Android 17 to the masses!

We’ve been hard at work rebasing all of our changes and features since Android 17’s release in June.
Android 17’s first release mainly contained iterative improvements and some UI/UX refinements, but
due to our previous efforts adapting to Google’s heavy refactoring over the last several versions,
we were able to rebase onto Android 17’s code-base faster than anticipated. Yes you read that right:
We’re early this year!

Security Patches

As always, we will merge full security bulletins and change the security patch level string to match
on all branches that Google actively distributes bulletins for - which as of writing is Android 14
(LineageOS 21) and newer.

We also plan to continue backporting and merging security bulletin patches to 18.1, 19.1, and 20.0,
though as there is no “attestable” set of patches provided by Google for these versions, we will not
modify the security patch level string.

Security patches from August 2025 to October 2026 have been merged to LineageOS 18.1 through 24.0.

This gets closer to closing the rather exhaustive effort to backport all feasible security patches.

The December 2025 bulletins pulled in some rather difficult to backport patches, which we were
unable to adapt - but if you’re able to, push them to Gerrit for review!

Security patches through November 2025 have been merged for the legacy branches 15.1, 16.0, and 17.1

WebView:

Installing LineageOS just got a little simpler.

We’re launching new browser-based flash tools for several common device-installation methods:

ADB

Fastboot

Amlogic Burn protocol

Samsung Odin protocol

These tools use WebUSB to communicate directly with compatible devices from your browser, reducing
the need to find, install, and run separate flashing utilities. They’re designed to make the installation
process more approachable, especially for users who are comfortable following device-specific instructions
but would rather avoid extra desktop software.

This does not replace our existing installation guides. The LineageOS Wiki will continue to document
the established installation methods, and those instructions remain the default and supported path for each device.

Instead, the WebUSB tools are an additional option for users who want a more streamlined flashing
experience. Availability and compatibility will vary by device, browser, operating system, and USB
connection, so please read the tool’s guidance carefully before proceeding.

As always, flashing custom software carries risk. Back up anything important, confirm that you
have selected the correct files and device, and follow the instructions presented by the tool.

You can try the new flash tools at flash.lineageos.org.

We’re excited to offer another way to make installing LineageOS more straightforward, while keeping
our established documentation and workflows intact.

Massive thank you to Contributors Nicholas Lim and Luk1337 for their hard work on these!

Deprecations / Legacy Devices

Overall, we feel that the 24.0 branch has reached feature and stability parity with 23.2 and is
ready for initial release.

LineageOS 24.0 will launch building for a decent selection of devices, with additional devices to
come as they meet the requirements specified by the
Charter and are
made ready for builds by their maintainer.

We would also like to announce formally that even though some devices using Linux Kernel versions 4.4 and 4.9
have been ported to LineageOS 23.2 and 24.0, we have decided to only accept LineageOS 22.2 submissions for
these devices. The legacy kernel versions and devices associated with them carry countless platform commits
that are rather hacky and difficult to continue to pull forward to newer Android versions.

LineageOS 22.2 still supports many devices running 4.4 and 4.9, and will continue to receive
builds and security patches merged monthly until Google stops distributing official security-bulletins
for Android 15 - and you can still submit new LineageOS 22.2 devices for official builds!

In addition, on LineageOS 23.2/24.0 we’re currently only shipping kernels that have 1:1 eBPF backports,
build fully without GCC, and have many other important backported features.

Upgrading to LineageOS 24.0

To upgrade, please follow the upgrade guide for your device by navigating to it here
and then by clicking on “Upgrade to a higher version of LineageOS”.

Please note that if you’re currently on an official build, you DO NOT need to wipe your device,
unless your device’s wiki page specifically dictates otherwise, as is needed for some devices with

Wiki

The LineageOS Wiki has also been expanded over the years and now
offers, in addition to the known and tested instructions for all supported devices, some
improvements:

Material Design 3 Expressive was implemented where possible!

Our FAQ has been greatly expanded, and the page redesigned

Samsung devices: Migrated away from ODIN/Heimdall to the awesome FOSS tool, samloader-rs

We’d also like to remind everyone to follow the instructions on their device’s respective Wiki page.
Android’s partitioning and update mechanisms have continued to evolve from system-as-root and A/B
partitions to dynamic partitions and Virtual A/B. Through all this change, the “typical” installation
steps that you may have once expected now be incomplete or incorrect for a particular device.

Our maintainers are expected to verify the published instructions for their devices, and the Wiki
provides increasingly flexible, device-specific guidance for installation, updates, and upgrades.
Please use it rather than relying on old guides, video guides, or steps remembered from a previous device.

Developers, Developers, Developers

Or, in this case, maintainers, maintainers, maintainers. We want your device submissions!

If you’re a developer and would like to submit your device for officials, it’s easier than ever.
Just follow the instructions here.

The above also applies to people looking to bring back devices that were at one point official but
are no longer supported - seriously - even if it’s not yet completely compliant, submit it! Maybe
we can help you complete it.

After you submit, within generally a few weeks, but in most cases a week, you’ll receive some
feedback on your device submission; and if it’s up to par, you’ll be invited to our communications
channels and your device will be forked to LineageOS’s official repositories.

Don’t have the knowledge to maintain a device, but want to contribute to the platform? We have lots
of other things you can contribute to.
For instance, our apps suite is always looking for new people to help
improve them, or you can
contribute to the wiki by adding
more useful information & documentation.
Gerrit is always open for submissions! Once
you’ve contributed a few things, email us at devrel(at)lineageos.org detailing your work, and we’ll
get you in the loop.

Generic Targets

We’ve talked about these before, but these are important, so we will cover them again.

Although we’ve had buildable generic targets since 2019, to make LineageOS more accessible to
developers, and really anyone interested in giving LineageOS a try, we’ve documented how to use
them in conjunction with the Android
Emulator/Android Studio!

Additionally, similar targets can now be used to build GSI in mobile, Android TV configurations,
and Android Automotive making LineageOS more accessible than ever to
devices using Google’s
Project Treble.
We won’t be providing official builds for these targets, due to the fact the user experience varies
entirely based on how well the device manufacturer complied with Treble’s requirements, but feel
free to go build them yourself and give it a shot!

Please note that Android 12 (and by proxy all later Android versions) diverged GSI and Emulator
targets. Emulator targets reside in lineage_sdk_$arch, while GSI targets reside in
lineage_gsi_$arch, and Cuttlefish targets
reside in lineage_cf_$arch.

Additionally, targets now exist for QEMU-based virtual machine software (libvirt, UTM, etc), which
have greatly improved in quality over the past year. Instructions on building and utilizing these
targets can be found on the Wiki.

And one more thing… The generic targets mentioned above all require either an existing Android device,
or some sort of virtualization/emulation software stack to run. Recently, Contributor 0xCAFEBABE
introduced a very different kind of generic target that can be run on various types of bare-metal
hardware devices.

While it’s still in experimental state, it has successfully booted on:

Common x86_64 PCs

Apple Silicon Macs

NVIDIA DGX Spark

Qualcomm Snapdragon X Series Laptops

And potentially more to come!

If interested, please take a look at the documentation here!

Translations

Bilingual? Trilingual? Anything-lingual?

If you think you can help translate LineageOS to a different language, jump over to
our wiki and have a go!
If your language is not supported natively in Android, reach out to us on Crowdin and we’ll take
the necessary
steps to include your language.
For instance, LineageOS is the first custom Android distribution that has complete support
for the Welsh (Cymraeg) language thanks to its community of translators.

Please, contribute to translations only if you are reasonably literate in the target language;
poor translations waste both our time and yours.

blocks.x: 24 - Getting Sentimental
Hey there! Welcome back!
We’re a bit sentimental about this release, as it precedes a really fun upcoming milestone.

On December 24, 2026, LineageOS will celebrate 10 years. It’s a remarkable milestone for a project
built by a passionate community of developers, maintainers, contributors, and users who have kept
so many devices alive along the way.

This release is part of that story: one more step forward, and a small moment to appreciate how
far we’ve come. Here’s to the next decade. And thank you for your continued patronage, support,
and belief in the project.

The last year has been crazy, but we have remained dedicated to bringing
an updated LineageOS based on Android 17 to the masses!

We’ve been hard at work rebasing all of our changes and features since Android 17’s release in June.
Android 17’s first release mainly contained iterative improvements and some UI/UX refinements, but
due to our previous efforts adapting to Google’s heavy refactoring over the last several versions,
we were able to rebase onto Android 17’s code-base faster than anticipated. Yes you read that right:
We’re early this year!
Security Patches
https://lineageos.org/images/2026-10-11/security-patch-level-by-branch.png
blocks.c: LineageOS Security Patch Level by Branch

blocks.x:
As always, we will merge full security bulletins and change the security patch level string to match
on all branches that Google actively distributes bulletins for - which as of writing is Android 14
(LineageOS 21) and newer.

We also plan to continue backporting and merging security bulletin patches to 18.1, 19.1, and 20.0,
though as there is no “attestable” set of patches provided by Google for these versions, we will not
modify the security patch level string.
Security patches from August 2025 to October 2026 have been merged to LineageOS 18.1 through 24.0.
This gets closer to closing the rather exhaustive effort to backport all feasible security patches.

The December 2025 bulletins pulled in some rather difficult to backport patches, which we were
unable to adapt - but if you’re able to, push them to Gerrit for review!
Security patches through November 2025 have been merged for the legacy branches 15.1, 16.0, and 17.1
Legacy branch patching has progressed greatly:
Application Updates

LineageOS isn’t just about the OS itself: our suite of core apps continues to evolve as well.
At this point, many of our applications are updated to Material Design 3 Expressive! Go check
them out! This cycle brings some major improvements:
Handles all your basic photo editing needs, such as: cropping, white balance, filters, etc.
Pairs well with our existing Glimpse gallery, and Aperture camera applications!
Canvas - A brand new image editor:
A battery indicator was added for mobile devices and handheld consoles
Various UI updates, mainly the animations and icons were revamped.
Catapult (Android TV Launcher) - Special thanks to Contributor Timi Rautamäki:
Updated to the newest upstream version.
Multiple fixes having been sent back to the upstream repo!
Etar:
Support PWA-like apps via the shortcut mechanism
Jelly (Browser)
Improved load times with a large media library
Now shows your “Most played” albums/genres in activity tab
Fixed audio tracks getting stuck with offload enabled
Improved Jellyfin support.
Twelve (Music)
More Material Design 3 Expressive goodness! Alongside a complete redesign including better animations and better branding

Updates are streamed by default!
This will greatly decrease installation time on A/B devices!
Improved UX and logical flow, as well as built-in notes to explain things to users
On non-A/B, the recovery partition is now automatically updated on the boot subsequent to a successful update
Tablet and TV layouts are greatly improved!
Updater - Special thanks to Contributor pjgowtham:
Updated to the newest upstream version.
Multiple fixes having been sent back to the upstream repo!
Seedvault:
Complete Material Design 3 Expressive implementation along with new fluid animations and beautiful assets
Onboarding flow rearchitected
Device-specific hooks to allow maintainers to insert device-specific pages for peripherals/etc.
SetupWizard - Special thanks to Contributor Saalim:
Has been updated to version 155.0.8059.30.
WebView:
Installing LineageOS just got a little simpler.
We’re launching new browser-based flash tools for several common device-installation methods:
ADB
Fastboot
Amlogic Burn protocol
Samsung Odin protocol

These tools use WebUSB to communicate directly with compatible devices from your browser, reducing
the need to find, install, and run separate flashing utilities. They’re designed to make the installation
process more approachable, especially for users who are comfortable following device-specific instructions
but would rather avoid extra desktop software.

This does not replace our existing installation guides. The LineageOS Wiki will continue to document
the established installation methods, and those instructions remain the default and supported path for each device.

Instead, the WebUSB tools are an additional option for users who want a more streamlined flashing
experience. Availability and compatibility will vary by device, browser, operating system, and USB
connection, so please read the tool’s guidance carefully before proceeding.

As always, flashing custom software carries risk. Back up anything important, confirm that you
have selected the correct files and device, and follow the instructions presented by the tool.
You can try the new flash tools at flash.lineageos.org.

We’re excited to offer another way to make installing LineageOS more straightforward, while keeping
our established documentation and workflows intact.
Massive thank you to Contributors Nicholas Lim and Luk1337 for their hard work on these!
CI/CD Improvements
We’ve done a lot of work to ensure submissions are properly tested and pre-reviewed, as well as build-tested:

Continuous Integration (CI) posts CI+1/CI-1 votes on most application repos, as well as several
other core repos. This CI runs things like:

Continuous Deployment (CD) now pushes APKs and other such build artifacts in a GitHub Actions
run each time a commit is merged.
A11Y Accessibility Audit

LineageOS just completed a full end-to-end installation process and application suite Accessibility
Audit that was performed free-of-charge by the a11y project!

We are greatly appreciative of their amazing work on this audit! The goal was to make LineageOS
more accessible - and some changes such as recovery navigation/UI have already seen reworking.

We are also very thankful for the free accessibility-in-development training they gave
over 40 contributors in a web-seminar!
Stay tuned for more information, and potentially a future blog post on outcomes!
Deprecations / Legacy Devices

Overall, we feel that the 24.0 branch has reached feature and stability parity with 23.2 and is
ready for initial release.

LineageOS 24.0 will launch building for a decent selection of devices, with additional devices to
come as they meet the requirements specified by the
Charter and are
made ready for builds by their maintainer.

We would also like to announce formally that even though some devices using Linux Kernel versions 4.4 and 4.9
have been ported to LineageOS 23.2 and 24.0, we have decided to only accept LineageOS 22.2 submissions for
these devices. The legacy kernel versions and devices associated with them carry countless platform commits
that are rather hacky and difficult to continue to pull forward to newer Android versions.

LineageOS 22.2 still supports many devices running 4.4 and 4.9, and will continue to receive
builds and security patches merged monthly until Google stops distributing official security-bulletins
for Android 15 - and you can still submit new LineageOS 22.2 devices for official builds!

In addition, on LineageOS 23.2/24.0 we’re currently only shipping kernels that have 1:1 eBPF backports,
build fully without GCC, and have many other important backported features.
Upgrading to LineageOS 24.0

To upgrade, please follow the upgrade guide for your device by navigating to it here
and then by clicking on “Upgrade to a higher version of LineageOS”.

If you’re coming from an unofficial build, you need to follow the good ole’ install guide for your
device, just like anyone else looking to
install LineageOS for the first time. These can be found at the same place
here by clicking on your device and then on “Installation”.

Please note that if you’re currently on an official build, you DO NOT need to wipe your device,
unless your device’s wiki page specifically dictates otherwise, as is needed for some devices with
massive changes, such as a repartition.
Careful Commonization

Several of our contributors have been working hard on SoC-specific common kernels that others
can base their kernels on, and merge on a somewhat regular basis to pull in the latest features/security
patches to save maintainers additional effort.
Go check them out and consider basing your device kernels on them!
Supported SoCs right now are:
SoC (system-on-chip)
Kernel Version
Android Version
AMLogic GXL/G12A/G12B/SM1
AMLogic G12A/G12B/SM1/NE/NO
Qualcomm MSM8998/MSM8996
Qualcomm MSM8953
Qualcomm SDM845
Qualcomm SM8150
Qualcomm SDM660
Qualcomm SM8250
Qualcomm SM8350
Qualcomm SM8450
Qualcomm SM8550
Qualcomm SM8650
Qualcomm SM8750
Qualcomm SM8850

Moreover, many legacy devices require interpolating libraries that we colloquially refer to as
“shims” - these have long been device and maintainer managed, but this cycle we have decided to
commonize them to make the effort easier on everyone and not duplicate effort!

You can check it out here and
contribute shims that other devices may need or add new components to additional
shims and compatibility layers. Head over to our guide
on using Gerrit to get started.
Wiki

The LineageOS Wiki has also been expanded over the years and now
offers, in addition to the known and tested instructions for all supported devices, some
improvements:
Material Design 3 Expressive was implemented where possible!
Our FAQ has been greatly expanded, and the page redesigned
Samsung devices: Migrated away from ODIN/Heimdall to the awesome FOSS tool, samloader-rs

We’d also like to remind everyone to follow the instructions on their device’s respective Wiki page.
Android’s partitioning and update mechanisms have continued to evolve from system-as-root and A/B
partitions to dynamic partitions and Virtual A/B. Through all this change, the “typical” installation
steps that you may have once expected now be incomplete or incorrect for a particular device.

Our maintainers are expected to verify the published instructions for their devices, and the Wiki
provides increasingly flexible, device-specific guidance for installation, updates, and upgrades.
Please use it rather than relying on old guides, video guides, or steps remembered from a previous device.
Developers, Developers, Developers
Or, in this case, maintainers, maintainers, maintainers. We want your device submissions!

If you’re a developer and would like to submit your device for officials, it’s easier than ever.
Just follow the instructions here.

The above also applies to people looking to bring back devices that were at one point official but
are no longer supported - seriously - even if it’s not yet completely compliant, submit it! Maybe
we can help you complete it.

After you submit, within generally a few weeks, but in most cases a week, you’ll receive some
feedback on your device submission; and if it’s up to par, you’ll be invited to our communications
channels and your device will be forked to LineageOS’s official repositories.

Don’t have the knowledge to maintain a device, but want to contribute to the platform? We have lots
of other things you can contribute to.
For instance, our apps suite is always looking for new people to help
improve them, or you can
contribute to the wiki by adding
more useful information & documentation.
Gerrit is always open for submissions! Once
you’ve contributed a few things, email us at devrel(at)lineageos.org detailing your work, and we’ll
get you in the loop.
Generic Targets
We’ve talked about these before, but these are important, so we will cover them again.

Although we’ve had buildable generic targets since 2019, to make LineageOS more accessible to
developers, and really anyone interested in giving LineageOS a try, we’ve documented how to use
them in conjunction with the Android
Emulator/Android Studio!

Additionally, similar targets can now be used to build GSI in mobile, Android TV configurations,
and Android Automotive making LineageOS more accessible than ever to
devices using Google’s
Project Treble.
We won’t be providing official builds for these targets, due to the fact the user experience varies
entirely based on how well the device manufacturer complied with Treble’s requirements, but feel
free to go build them yourself and give it a shot!

Please note that Android 12 (and by proxy all later Android versions) diverged GSI and Emulator
targets. Emulator targets reside in lineage_sdk_$arch, while GSI targets reside in
lineage_gsi_$arch, and Cuttlefish targets
reside in lineage_cf_$arch.

Additionally, targets now exist for QEMU-based virtual machine software (libvirt, UTM, etc), which
have greatly improved in quality over the past year. Instructions on building and utilizing these
targets can be found on the Wiki.

And one more thing… The generic targets mentioned above all require either an existing Android device,
or some sort of virtualization/emulation software stack to run. Recently, Contributor 0xCAFEBABE
introduced a very different kind of generic target that can be run on various types of bare-metal
hardware devices.
While it’s still in experimental state, it has successfully booted on:
Common x86_64 PCs
Apple Silicon Macs
NVIDIA DGX Spark
Qualcomm Snapdragon X Series Laptops
And potentially more to come!
If interested, please take a look at the documentation here!
Translations
Bilingual? Trilingual? Anything-lingual?

If you think you can help translate LineageOS to a different language, jump over to
our wiki and have a go!
If your language is not supported natively in Android, reach out to us on Crowdin and we’ll take
the necessary
steps to include your language.
For instance, LineageOS is the first custom Android distribution that has complete support
for the Welsh (Cymraeg) language thanks to its community of translators.

Please, contribute to translations only if you are reasonably literate in the target language;
poor translations waste both our time and yours.

lululemon 开启「一起好状态」活动，会发声的乒乓台来到上海


七部门发文纠治电商「自动跟价」「全网最低价」竞争


胖东来梦之城公示酒店规划，高度不超过 99.95 米


周末也值得一看的新闻


库克现身广州，探班 iPhone 18 Pro 咏春短片拍摄现场

10 月 10 日，苹果董事会执行主席蒂姆·库克（Tim Cook）再次来到中国，并将此行首站选在广州，探班使用 iPhone 18 Pro 系列拍摄的咏春主题短片。


拍摄由青年导演古天鸡与咏春拳传承人戴子龙参与，在岭南风格的园林实景中，通过手机影像呈现中国传统武术。


探班期间，库克现场观看了咏春拳演示，并与主创团队交流移动影像拍摄及专业工作流程。据介绍，拍摄团队利用 iPhone 18 Pro 系列的摄像头系统，在低光环境下记录快速变化的咏春招式。此外，古天鸡团队还向库克展示了一份使用 iPad Pro 搭配 Apple Pencil Pro 绘制的「武功秘籍」，以数字绘画的形式呈现咏春拳法。


库克随后在社交平台表示：「很高兴再次来到中国！在广州第一次透过 iPhone 18 Pro 镜头感受咏春的魅力，真是一次难忘的体验。」


值得一提的是，这是库克今年 9 月卸任苹果 CEO、转任董事会执行主席后首次到访中国。苹果现任 CEO 为约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）。


曝苹果 iPhone Duo 加单 30%，Pro 系列总订单量不变

据证券时报报道，苹果对今年秋季新款手机的订单作出结构性调整：iPhone Duo 加单 30%，调整后的总量仍未超过 1000 万台。


与此同时，iPhone 18 Pro 订单减少 10% 至 15%，iPhone 18 Pro Max 订单增加 10% 至 15%，Pro 系列总订单量保持不变。报道援引苹果供应链人士称，订单结构正向价值更高的产品倾斜，预计有利于相关供应链公司的业绩。


苹果第二期中国清洁能源基金扩容至 2.12 亿美元

10 月 10 日，苹果宣布第二期中国清洁能源基金的承诺投资总额增至 2.12 亿美元，约合 14 亿元人民币。新能源科技、鹏鼎控股与达尔科技等供应商加入出资，基金已完成初步投资，支持广西 260 兆瓦、山东 50 兆瓦两处风电项目，均已开工建设。


苹果同时公布，其在中国超过 95% 的直接生产制造现已采用可再生能源，目标是到 2030 年底在全球供应链全面使用可再生能源。由施罗德资本管理的第二期基金，计划每年为中国电网新增 110 万兆瓦时的风能和太阳能发电能力。


在工业供热减排方面，苹果正与山东创新精密推进铝材熔炼电气化，将已完成示范运行的电感应炉技术用于 MacBook Air 规模化生产。苹果还将向中国绿色碳汇基金会和北京自然之友公益基金会提供新资助，分别支持森林与城市碳汇试点、社区应对气候变化方案。


四部门拟禁全隐藏式车门把手，要求车企如实宣传使用边界


10 月 10 日，工业和信息化部等四部门发布汽车产品创新设计和研发测试验证管理通知征求意见稿，拟禁止配备全隐藏式门把手，并要求车企真实、客观开展营销宣传，如实说明创新设计的使用边界、限制条件和测试验证情况。


征求意见稿针对跟风推出新产品、测试验证不充分等问题提出要求：涉及安全的应急操纵件应保留实体操纵件和醒目标识；门把手须具备机械冗余设计和手部操作空间，并验证极端环境及紧急情况下的可操作性。行车时不可使用「零重力」座椅、旋转座椅或座椅放倒成床等功能。


按拟议安排，2027 年 1 月 1 日起，涉及创新设计的新申报产品需补充技术参数并完成相应测试；已取得公告的产品应在 2027 年 7 月 1 日前补报参数及验证材料。环境适应性验证周期不少于 1 年，可靠性验证试验不低于 3 万公里。


宣传方面，车企不得作虚假、夸大或引人误解的宣传，不得使用违反道路交通法规的场景展示产品功能，也不得诱导驾驶人忽视安全驾驶责任。上述要求目前处于公开征求意见阶段。


字节据报加速个人 AI 智能体，拟将 Spell 与豆包结合


据财新报道，字节跳动正在加快个人 AI 智能体的研发，计划把代号为 Spell 的项目与豆包产品结合，尽快对外推出。财新 10 月 9 日从字节内部人士处获悉，这项研发在国庆假期前已加紧推进。


Spell 项目于今年 4 月启动，延续了 2025 年豆包手机助手在个人智能体方向上的探索。彼时，豆包内部已启动相关产品内测。


报道介绍，新产品由豆包手机助手团队主导，Spell 项目与豆包对话团队共同负责。Meta Muse 等个人智能体在海外走红后，字节进一步加快了项目进度。


Meta 据报暂缓向 Anthropic 提供 AI 算力


据《华尔街日报》报道，Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 今年早些时候曾致电 Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang，寻求更多算力。Meta 内部讨论后，最终决定暂时不向 Anthropic 提供芯片算力。


Claude Code 的意外走红让 Anthropic 遭遇算力紧张，并导致服务频繁中断。为寻找资源，联合创始人 Tom Brown 在 3 月底到 xAI 办公室与马斯克商谈；Anthropic 随后于 5 月宣布与 SpaceX 达成协议，租用超过 300 兆瓦算力。


报道指出，大量数据中心仍处于建设阶段，眼下可实际使用的容量远少于宣布中的规模。成熟供应商开始要求多年合同和更高预付款，一些初创公司则转向安全或基础设施较弱的服务商。还有公司为防备未来短缺而超额预订，也有公司因产品需求不及预期，被迫转售剩余容量。


Netflix 称约 300 部作品已使用 AI，导演谈降本与创作取舍

Netflix 亚太制作高级总监 Lee Sung-gyun 在釜山国际电影节论坛上表示，公司约有 300 部作品已以不同方式使用 AI，应用环节包括预演、美术设计、布景构思、剪辑和视觉特效。


据 Variety 现场报道，Netflix 展示了旗下 Eyeline 工作室结合实拍、传统特效和生成工具的混合制作流程。印度作品《Glory》也借助 AI 与视觉特效完成大规模人群场面；Lee 称，在原有预算和工期下，这些镜头本来可能被舍弃。


同场的《犯罪都市》导演姜允成介绍，他为海上军事题材项目《The Gulf of Aden》用可灵制作过全 AI 测试片。团队为融资测算时，预计采用这套流程可将制作预算降低约 40%，节省来自特效、拍摄简化与周期缩短。这是具体项目的测算，并非已完成影片的普遍降本比例。


姜允成同时指出，AI 让一些曾因预算取消的项目重新具备可行性，但也可能省去多人讨论、尝试和积累经验的过程。他认为，画面质量虽提升，传达情感、打动观众仍需人的创作；Lee 也强调，生成结果最终需要人再处理一次。


长鑫披露 4F² 内存架构进展，首款服务器产品预计年底推出

长鑫存储总裁曹堪宇在 10 月 10 日的第四届集成芯片和芯粒大会上披露，长鑫预计年底推出采用 4F² 架构的新一代 DDR5 RDIMM 服务器内存产品。据第一财经、21 世纪经济报道，这项技术在存储单元和制造工艺两方面作出调整。


目前 DRAM 主流存储单元采用 6F² 架构，F 代表最小特征尺寸。4F² 将单元面积缩小至四倍最小特征尺寸的平方，提高单位面积的存储密度。长鑫采用自研 VSG 垂直包围沟道晶体管，让晶体管竖立布置，以增强栅极控制能力，改善漏电与短沟道效应。


另一项调整是将 DRAM 存储阵列与 CMOS 外围逻辑电路的制造工艺分开，再通过晶圆级混合键合实现互联，使逻辑性能和存储密度可以分别优化。曹堪宇称，长鑫相关公开专利族已超过 300 件。


首代产品选择服务器用 DDR5 RDIMM，这类内存需要满足持续运行、稳定性和兼容性要求。此次披露的是研发进展与年底产品计划。


英伟达据报洽谈收购 Reflection AI，也可能追加投资

据《金融时报》援引直接知情人士报道，英伟达正就收购美国开放权重模型公司 Reflection AI，或进一步加深投资关系展开谈判。磋商仍在早期，交易可能在未来数周达成，也可能告吹，双方均拒绝置评。


潜在方案包括完整收购、追加股权投资，以及「收购式招聘」：英伟达聘用其员工并获得技术许可。另一种可能是提供更多芯片和算力。《金融时报》称，英伟达已向 Reflection 投入 8 亿美元，是其最大股东之一；这家公司今年 3 月融资时的估值为 250 亿美元。


Reflection 由曾参与 Google Gemini 研发的 Misha Laskin 和 Ioannis Antonoglou 创立，本周刚推出首款可定制的公开 AI 产品，运行在英伟达芯片上。开放权重模型允许用户在自己的硬件上运行并进行定制，Reflection 也是美国发展本土开放模型生态的参与者。


英伟达已有 Nemotron 开放权重模型系列。《金融时报》指出，公司目前仍缺少自己的前沿规模模型。


东芝人力负责人：AI 改变初级岗位，面试更看重解决问题的过程

AI 开始筛选简历之后，初级招聘人员如何积累经验？东芝美洲区首席人力资源官 Jason Richard Desentz 在 Business Insider 刊发的口述文章中表示，初级岗位仍会保留，但工作内容和招聘标准正在变化。


他举例说，面对上千份简历，招聘人员往往看完前几十份、找到一些合适人选就会停下，余下的好候选人可能被漏掉。东芝为招聘建立 AI Bot，希望让人员把时间转向与经理确认需求、设计更好的问题和改善新人入职体验；AI 生成的面试指南也应帮助找到需要追问的地方，而非直接排除可能学会工作的人。


面试时，Desentz 更关注候选人如何拆解问题、用数据支持判断、推动没有积极参与的同组成员，以及面对突然变化的预算或任务期限如何调整方案。没有工作经验的人，也可以用大学里的真实经历说明思考过程。


对于员工担忧，他主张承认工作正在变化，带着团队一起应对。东芝从员工最不喜欢的重复事务入手试做 Bot，并安排 AI 基础课程和内部展示。他强调要给员工留出试验时间，允许他们在学习中犯错。


腾讯云开源 TeamAI，团队 Skill 可跨 Agent 共享

腾讯云近日对外介绍并开源内部使用的 TeamAI 工具，希望把分散在不同 AI 编程工具里的团队配置、Skill 和经验，通过 Git 仓库统一管理。项目采用 MIT 许可证，已提供 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、CodeBuddy 等工具的适配。


TeamAI 将能力分为三层：

团队执行层：集中发布 Skill、Rules、MCP、文档和模型配置，让成员在不同 Agent 中使用同一套团队规范；支持在新会话中同步管理员发布的更新。


团队上下文层：汇集项目知识、任务经验和代码知识图谱，并以 teamwiki 等形式供后续任务使用。


团队改进层：通过使用情况、会话记录和看板观察团队采用情况，帮助维护共享配置。

后两层仍标记为 Beta。成员可以继续使用各自熟悉的编程工具，团队共享内容则在同一仓库内维护和更新。


银河战舰 700 上市，先享价 17.98 万元起


10 月 10 日，吉利银河战舰 700 在杭州上市，共推出三种动力、六款车型。入门两驱探索版先享指导价为 17.98 万元，叠加置换补贴后的限时焕新价为 16.98 万元。


新车基于 GTA 原生新能源越野架构，将一体式大梁嵌入车身，全系采用五座布局。动力与底盘按版本分层：

1.5T 两驱版侧重日常通勤，CLTC 纯电续航 305km，综合续航最高 1770km。


1.5T 三电机四驱版综合功率 690kW，零百加速 4.2 秒；2.0T 三电机四驱版提升至 830kW，零百加速 3.95 秒，并配备低速四驱与后桥机械差速锁。


陆地方舟版进一步加入主动液压悬架、应急漂浮脱困和制氧系统。

全系配备 47.14kWh 宁德时代磷酸铁锂电池，支持峰值 6C 快充。座舱采用 Flyme Auto 2，保留实体挡杆与越野功能按键，前后排座椅通风、加热为标配；官方还提供车顶帐篷拓展方案。


本次限时上市权益要求用户在 10 月 31 日前完成大定锁单、尾款支付和提车，置换补贴另有适用条件。


阿里升级 NBA Chat，赛事回放可在 10 至 15 秒内生成

NBA 中国赛 2026 于 10 月 9 日在中国澳门开赛。阿里巴巴介绍，基于千问打造的智能篮球助手 NBA Chat 已升级为多模态交互，支持语音提问、文字及视频回复，并接入 NBA 知识图谱和视频媒资库。


NBA Chat 同时上线三个角色化 Agent，分别采用马布里、解说员王猛和篮球主播美娜的风格，提供互动、解说及赛后资讯。去年首次用于 NBA 赛场的 360 度实时回放技术，今年加入「主角时刻」：由 Wan3.0 视频与图像生成模型支持，聚焦攻防球员，在 10 至 15 秒内生成环绕回放。


场内观众可用自己的照片生成独行侠或火箭队主题 AI 视频，线上球迷也能在千问 App 使用同款能力。淘宝 88VIP 连续第二年成为中国赛首席合作伙伴，提供门票抽奖、优先通道、前排席位、定制联名周边及球星互动等权益。高德则在 NBA House 提供室内导航、机器狗导览，并开设扫街榜线下市集。


小米澎湃 OS 4 正式版 10 月 15 日起分批推送


小米澎湃 OS 公告君 10 月 10 日公布升级安排：澎湃 OS 4 正式版将于 10 月 15 日起陆续分批推送，首批覆盖 Xiaomi 17 系列、REDMI K100 Pro 系列等机型，之后逐步扩展至更多存量设备。


据公告，Beta 版内测招募将于 10 月 14 日中午 12 点结束。仍希望参与的用户可在小米社区内测中心报名，通过后在「设置—我的设备—系统版本」中升级。


本轮正式版包含超级小爱 2.0 与 MiMo 大模型相关能力，带来专家模式、灵感球交互，并升级跨设备协同与系统流畅度。


阿里 Qoder 上线 Fast 模式，首次响应缩短至 3 秒


阿里 Qoder 10 月 10 日上线 Fast 模式，率先用于桌面端，需更新至 0.4.4 及以上版本。个人版和企业版均可使用，中国版与国际版同步支持。


中国版新增 Fast 档位，国际版原有的 Performance 模式则直接升级为 Fast，原用户无需额外操作。官方给出的数据是，首次响应时间由 8 秒缩短至 3 秒，Credits 消耗系数由 1.1x 降至 0.8x，约减少 27%；其表示输出质量保持不变。


Qoder 产品家族的其他产品也计划陆续加入 Fast 模式，目前这项更新首先面向桌面端开放。


罗技预览矩阵式会议音箱，可将两种语言投向不同座区

罗技 10 月 8 日预览 Rally Speaker 2 Pro 和 Rally Speaker 2 Max 两款音频系统，以自研 Sound Shape 技术进入专业视听市场。两款音箱安装在房间前方，分别使用 32 个和 64 个微型驱动单元，面向大型会议室和培训空间。


这套系统通过控制声波的叠加与抵消，把声音投向指定听音区域，同时减少声音向墙壁等方向扩散。罗技称，这可以降低反射和回声，并让前后排保持更均匀的音量，减少传统天花板音箱的布线和安装需求。


罗技还演示了一个仍在开发的多语言方案：单台 Max 可同时把两路不同音频投向房间两侧，例如左侧听英语、右侧听法语。公司正与合作伙伴研究接入 Microsoft Teams 的 Interpreter 和 Zoom Meetings 的 Voice Translator。


两款产品现可在罗技硅谷体验中心演示，计划于 2027 年夏季商业上市。


RSIGym 开源，让 AI 自主设计实验、训练并改进模型


Evolvent AI 团队开源了 RSIGym，把训练、推理、评测和沙箱执行做成 AI 可以调用的服务。研究 Agent 自行设计实验、生成训练数据、训练候选模型，再根据结果调整方案；平台统一管理权限和预算，并公开实验轨迹。


环境提供三种路线：只改训练数据、固定模型权重而改执行框架，以及同时优化数据、训练设置和框架。主实验让 6 个研究 Agent 在 5 个领域中改进同一个起点：Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 加最小执行框架，每次基准实验的平台服务预算为 500 美元，研究 Agent 推理和最终正式评测费用另计。


团队报告，30 次联合优化实验中有 29 次优于初始系统。Opus 5 的 RSI-Index 最高，为 0.4809，表示平均弥补了距满分剩余差距的 48.09%，并非最终准确率。每种研究配置只运行一次，最终评测复用了开发阶段可见的任务。


另一项让 Qwen3.8-27B 研究自身的实验，则从初始 56.66% 降至 56.26%：小规模开发集上的进步没有转化为整体提升。该结果展示了自动研究的可执行过程，也保留了自我改进未必奏效的边界。


2027 款启源 A06 上市，限时权益价 11.69 万元起

2027 款长安启源 A06 于 10 月 10 日上市，共提供 5 款配置，官方指导价从 11.99 万元至 15.99 万元，限时权益价为 11.69 万元至 15.69 万元。此次改款新增「激昂红」车色，并增加 800km 长续航版本。


新车全系标配宁德时代电池，采用 800V 碳化硅高压平台，支持 6C 闪充，CLTC 纯电续航分为 630km 和 800km 两档。CNMO 引述的补能数据为，电量从 30% 充至 80% 需要 9 分钟。


车身长宽高为 4885×1916×1496mm，轴距 2922mm，底盘采用全铝前双叉臂加后五连杆悬架。配置序列包括 630 舒享版、630 尊享版、630 激光耀享版，以及 800 激光远航版、800 激光旗舰版。


lululemon 开启「一起好状态」活动，会发声的乒乓台来到上海

lululemon 连续第六年发起「一起好状态」年度活动。10 月 7 日，首场感受日在上海上音歌剧院举行，李宇春、邓亚萍、残奥铁三运动员王家超、人文学者梁永安及正念导师 Jesse Israel，通过演讲、对话和呼吸习练，讨论身体、心理与社交三个维度的好状态。


艺术家 James de Wulf 创作的「幸福的回响」乒乓台也首次来到中国。这件曾在 2025 年巴黎 Design Miami 展出的装置，以经过特殊调音的哑光铝板制作，乒乓球落在不同位置时会触发不同音调。邓亚萍与艺术家在现场挥拍演示了这套声音互动。


10 月 8 日至 18 日，乒乓台将在上海西岸中环限时展出，公众可参与体验。10 月 10 日至 17 日，lululemon 还将联合上海多家场馆推出八天主题热汗课程，全国门店同步举办系列课程。活动将上音歌剧院的对话与运动体验延伸至社区。


七部门发文纠治电商「自动跟价」「全网最低价」竞争


商务部等七部门发布实施品质电商「五优」行动的通知，提出协同整治无序非理性竞争，纠治电商平台「自动跟价」「全网最低价」等行为，并规范平台佣金抽成、商家评级规则，避免挤压品质商家的生存空间。


通知要求，电商平台制定、修改规则时，落实规则公示和公开征求意见；优化商品展示、推荐和营销活动机制，将商品质量、服务口碑和信用信息作为品质导向。有关部门还将建立平台与中小商家的对话沟通机制，打击刷单炒信。


在全链路品控方面，通知引导平台建立首席质量官制度，完善线上服务质量评价体系，并支持政务数据核验，协助平台比对商家证照。围绕「618」「双 11」等消费节点，各方将加强对平台的指导与规范。


胖东来梦之城公示酒店规划，高度不超过 99.95 米

胖东来梦之城的酒店、文化中心和幸福讲堂规划进入批前公示。许昌市自然资源和规划局 10 月 9 日公布的二至四期建设工程规划许可信息显示，四期酒店规划面积约 6.6 万平方米，建筑高度不超过 99.95 米。


另外两个配套项目中，二期幸福讲堂面积 5630 平方米、高度不超过 24 米；三期文化中心面积约 3.62 万平方米、高度不超过 25.45 米。


据极目新闻此前披露的规划信息，梦之城一期主要建设商业综合体，建筑面积约 46.7 万平方米，主体共 8 层。项目位于许昌市东城区、莲城大道以北和许州路以东，临近高铁许昌东站。


于东来曾在 7 月表示，梦之城将在 3 年内开业。此次公示展示的是酒店等后续配套的规划内容。


是周末啊！


One Fun Thing｜经典 Fiat 500 变身电动海滨小车

意大利汽车定制工作室 Garage Italia 把经典 Fiat 500 Spiaggina 改造成了一辆电动敞篷小车。它沿用无车门、开放式车身与可拆卸顶篷的海滨车设定，面向停靠地中海港口后、需要在沿岸小镇短途出行的游艇用户。


据 Design Milk 介绍，这辆车在后部装入电动机，搭配 11kWh 电池，WLTP 续航约 140 公里。车主可以选择 18 种车身颜色，也可以定制色彩；顶篷、坐垫采用意大利纺织品牌 Mariaflora 的面料，Bonacina 手工编织的座椅则提供藤编或耐日晒、盐雾的复合材料版本，地板使用防水 EVA 材料。


这套改造保留了 Fiat 500 Jolly 当年为海边休闲出行而做的形态，动力改成电驱后，游艇上也无需再为它携带汽油。车辆起价为 8.5 万欧元，选装和税费另计。


周末看什么｜《Animals》让一场绑架案撕开竞选家庭的秘密

洛杉矶市长候选人 Mark Kimball 正在为选举奔忙，一通电话却告知他的儿子遭到绑架。在 Netflix 已上线的惊悚片《Animals》中，他与妻子 Abigail 必须筹措赎金，而夫妻关系、竞选利益与家庭秘密也在这一夜接连暴露。


影片由本·阿弗莱克执导并出演 Mark，凯丽·华盛顿饰演 Abigail，史蒂文·元饰演竞选经理，吉莲·安德森出演协助处理危机的神秘掮客。故事在洛杉矶展开，竞选团队试图维持的公众形象，与一家人在绑架案中的选择不断发生冲突。


Variety 影评人 Guy Lodge 肯定影片紧凑的推进和阿弗莱克逐渐失控的表演，也指出政治讽刺、婚姻冲突与通俗惊悚元素之间的切换，削弱了部分情节的真实感。他认为影片靠接连转折保持吸引力，但没有把对权力和不平等的追问展开到底。


买书不读指南｜《创意行为：存在即答案》从注意力谈起

音乐制作人里克·鲁宾在《创意行为：存在即答案》中，把创作放回日常的观察、感知和选择。他以自己与不同类型音乐人合作的经验为起点，讨论怎样留意线索、保存灵感、进行试验，以及把尚未成形的想法逐步推进到完成。


全书由 78 篇思考组成，话题涉及初学者心态、自我怀疑、习惯、合作与规则。开篇「人人都是创作者」把重新布置房间、解决问题、开展对话也纳入创造的范围；鲁宾将艺术家的生活方式描述为一种注意力实践，强调感知、过滤信息与形成经验之间的联系。


英文原作 The Creative Act: A Way of Being 于 2023 年出版。中文版由重轻翻译，中信出版集团于 2025 年 4 月推出，共 416 页。鲁宾曾与阿黛尔、Jay-Z、Johnny Cash 等音乐人合作，他将音乐制作经验转化为围绕创作过程的思考。


游戏推荐｜《沉星之序》

《时空幻境》《见证者》的制作人 Jonathan Blow 与 Thekla 团队带来新作《沉星之序》。这款叙事解谜冒险游戏包含超过 1000 个手工设计的谜题，玩家将在四个规则各异的平行世界里探索，逐步解锁新的角色与机制。


女王、盗贼、战士、巫师，甚至一艘会说话的小船，都可以成为可操控角色。每个世界有独立的故事、规则和危险；随着角色相遇、世界交汇，原本分开的能力与解谜机制也会相互组合。玩家可以按自己的节奏探索，随时返回不同世界，并通过散落的笔记拼出故事。


游戏由 Arc Games 与 Gamirror Games 发行，已于 10 月 8 日登陆 Steam，支持 Windows PC，提供简体中文界面和字幕。中文配音计划在发售后约一个月更新。截至 10 月 11 日，Steam 总体评价为「好评如潮」。
